articleTitle: Design of Barker-7 Radar Pulse Compressor Using DSP Architecture Minimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Pulse compression algorithms play an important role in achieving better range resolution (RR) in automobile radar and ultrasonic sensors. The RR is the sensor's capacity to distinguish between two targets positioned in the same angular direction but at different distances. The Digital Signal Processing Architecture (DSPA) used in the pulse compressor is crucial for reaching high speeds or reducing hardware needs. This work presents two unique radar pulse compressor DSPAs for Barker-7 sequences, based on latency and area. One proposed design is the unfolding DSPA technology, which increases sample rate and speed. At the same time, another architecture, the folding DSPA approach, reduces hardware utilization and power consumption. The proposed DSPA design architectures are implemented and verified with the Artix-7 FPGA Kit. The unfolded Barker-7 pulse compressor increased the speed by 1.87 times as compared to the standard broadcasting Barker-7 realization, as demonstrated by the hardware implementation results. Folded Barker-7 architecture consumed 89% less power than existing Barker-7 broadcast architecture. The DSPAs proposed for the Barker-7 pulse compressor are ideal for ultrasonic, sonar, and radar applications that require high speed and low power.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Technology of Orbital Satellite Communication System Based on Consistency Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Communication technology is widely used in urban rail transportation with its advantages of convenient operation and large amount of information, and occupies a large proportion. In rail transportation, communication information transmission system is an important guarantee for communication information security. Communication information transmission system is through the communication system to transmit messages, the choice of safe, reliable, convenient and efficient communication information transmission system is to ensure the information security is an important guarantee, but also the entire railroad “artery”. Only by constantly analyzing and researching, constantly carrying out research, and constantly carrying out technological innovation, can we give full play to its function and its due value. This paper is based on the above problems to explore the consistency algorithm based on the orbit satellite communication system transmission technology, first of all, respectively introduced the consistency algorithm and the orbit satellite communication system, and then through the experiments to verify the consistency algorithm based on the performance of the orbit satellite communication system (in the SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) in the 10dB, the experimental group's PAPR performance of value is around 0.35 and the PAPR value of the control group is around 0.05).

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Method based on Deep Learning in Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: As new energy continues to become an important part of the power system, it constitutes a new type of power system with great progress and advantages in power generation and energy consumption. However, due to the uncertainty of new energy, there are many problems in the operation of the new power system. The emergence of data mining technology is able to mine the unknown and hidden information and relationship in the data generated and accumulated by the power system, and achieve the prediction and solution of the problems. In this paper, we will describe the application of data mining technology in the power system, focus on analyzing the application of neural network technology in data mining in the diagnosis of power equipment and new energy output prediction in the new type of power system, and finally summarize the application of data mining technology in the new type of power system and make a future outlook.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis and Optimal Design of Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) Microcantilever by Introducing Stress Concentration Region
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This Paper is deeply concentrated on the various geometrical design and simulations of MEMS-based microcantilever to maximize the sensitivity and to obtain higher accuracy. FEA was used to carry out different Designs with different materials. This paper demonstrates the finite element analysis to obtain the optimal performance of SiO2 based microcantilevers sensor by optimizing the geometrical dimension of the cantilever. Silicon is selected to carryout various design simulations due to its influencing factors and familiar properties. According to the variance analysis, a microcantilever induced with some Stress Concentration Region (SCR) and proper positioning of the Stress Concentration Region gives a much better result that increases the sensitivity of the microcantilever than that of a conventional one.

articleTitle: Enhancing Noise Immunity of Schmitt Triggers through Dual PMOS Transistor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This brief highlights the noise immune Schmitt trigger circuit. The proposed circuit is configured with dual PMOS feedback circuitry, which makes the leakage power resilient. The proposed circuit has 1.84x, 2.35x less dynamic and leakage power and 1.74x improvement in propagation delay. The proposed circuit is noise immune as 0.93x improvement in hysteresis width. All simulation work has been handled by Cadence Virtuosos tool at 45 nm technology node.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Dispatching Optimization of New Energy Grid Considering the Impact of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Wind power has strong instability and stochasticity, which bring great challenges to the grid dispatch operation system. In order to make up for the shortcomings of existing studies that neglect the uncertain out-of-set risks and fail to fully consider the demand flexibility, there is an urgent need to establish a new grid intelligent scheduling system. Therefore, this paper firstly analyses the characteristics of wind energy, describes the impact of wind energy on the new energy grid, and summarises and introduces the planning method of the grid accessed by wind power. Then, it fully utilises the advantages of artificial intelligence algorithms and classical mathematical algorithms and proposes an optimisation model for new energy grid dispatch containing wind power with an improved particle swarm algorithm. It effectively reduces the risk of distribution grid scheduling and can provide guidance for realising more efficient and stable new energy grid scheduling containing wind power.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mobility: A Smart Cane with Integrated Navigation System and Voice-Assisted Guidance for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Blindness is a condition which affects many people, and for the affected people, quality of life can take a big hit. Most blind people already use walking sticks to feel the terrain in front of them as they move around and navigate using touch and sound. However, they cannot judge distances to objects until the cane actually hits the object. In some cases, the contact with the cane may damage the object. Hence, it may be better to have some early warning system so that there is less likelihood of causing damage. This paper presents the design and development of a “Smart Cane” aimed at enhancing mobility and safety for visually impaired individuals. The cane incorporates ultrasonic sensors to detect objects in the user's surroundings. When an object is detected within a specified distance range, the cane provides haptic feedback through a bidirectional vibration motor, alerting the user to its presence. The microcontroller-based system processes data from both sensors and efficiently manages power consumption to ensure extended battery life. The device's design includes user-friendly controls and an ergonomic enclosure to offer ease of use and protection for the electronic components. Further, there is built-in navigation via online Map API. With the convenience of navigating oneself without external assistance, the “Smart Cane” demonstrates great potential to improve the independence and confidence of visually impaired individuals in navigating their environments safely.

articleTitle: Action Detection for Sign Language using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This study focuses on overcoming communication challenges for individuals with hearing impairments by exploring automated recognition of sign language signals. People with hearing impairments can communicate better and engage with the community more effectively when automated sign language signals are recognised. Utilizing deep learning, particularly Long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithms, the system analyses images or videos of manual sign signals captured by a camera, predicting corresponding sign language expressions. This innovative approach, leveraging temporal dependencies in gestures, aims to efficiently reduce the communication gap, providing an advanced and effective solution for sign language interpretation.

articleTitle: Area and Speed-Efficient Floating-Point Arithmetic Logical Unit Implementation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Arithmetic and Logic Unit is a CPU component that performs arithmetic and logical operations on data. The execution of the multiple instructions in a computer program is required. ALUs frequently feature, among other things, adders, multipliers, and logical units. These components work together to conduct a range of calculations. Ideas and approaches for building the computing units of the ALU are offered. The design also includes a suggested splitter mechanism. The whole ALU is written in Verilog, stressing the usage of a high-level hardware description language in the paper. FALU is widely employed as a key component of DSPs for real-time signal and data processing. The research suggests creating an area- and speed-optimized FALU to increase the performance of DSPs in present computing contexts. The processing power and performance of processors utilized in real-time signal processing applications. The paper's goal is to improve both the speed and the area efficiency of real-time signal processing applications. The Arithmetic and Logic Unit is an important component that performs arithmetic and logical operations on data. The whole ALU is implemented using Verilog, a high-level hardware description language. FALU is designed for speed and space efficiency.

articleTitle: Bidirectional DC Converter Using Li-Ion Battery for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: As a green and sustainable means of transportation, electric vehicles (EVs) have attracted a lot of interest. The Li- Ion batteries, which store and transmit electrical energy to power the vehicle's propulsion system, are essential to the effective operation of EVs. For a battery to last longer, have a greater driving range, and be reliable, effective battery management, including charging and discharging procedures, is essential. This abstract offers a summary of the key elements of employing bidirectional DC converters to charge and discharge Li-Ion batteries in electric vehicles. The bidirectional DC converter is essential for controlling the flow of electricity between the battery pack of the car and outside DC sources like charging ports and regenerative braking systems. The battery can be charged while connected to an external power source, and stored energy can be discharged to power the vehicle with no interruptions because to this technology's flawless bidirectional energy transfer capability

articleTitle: Enhancing Goal Achievement through Collaborative Goal Tracking: A Recommender System Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An innovative goal tracking application that encourages cooperation among users with similar goals is presented in this research. The app uses a strong recommender system to link users based on goal keywords, forming a helpful community, going beyond tracking each user's progress individually. The goal of the study is to assess how well collaborative features increase user engagement and goal achievement rates by examining the shortcomings of current goal tracking apps. The outcomes demonstrate how effective teamwork can be and pave the way for a revolutionary method of goal monitoring. Setting the stage for future improvements that promise a more inclusive and flexible goal tracking experience, such as machine learning-based personalized recommendations, this research lays the groundwork.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Trust Model for Ethereum Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid proliferation of blockchain technology, Ethereum has emerged as a prominent platform for decentralised applications and smart contracts. Ensuring the integrity and reliability of the Ethereum network is paramount for its sustained success. This research introduces an innovative approach for approximating the trust levels of Ethereum nodes, which is crucial for maintaining the network's security and performance. Leveraging the Mamdani fuzzy model, this study proposes a comprehensive framework that evaluates trustworthiness by considering multiple parameters, including token count. Transaction count and Ether percentage held by Ethereum node user. These parameters are fuzzified and transformed into linguistic variables, then processed through a Mamdani Fuzzy Model. The model uses predefined linguistic rules and membership functions to assign a trust score to each node user.

articleTitle: Polarization Reconfigured Slot Antenna for Aircraft Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The reconfigured slot antennas have been proposed in this article. These Microstrip Patch Antennas (MPA) consist of an O-shaped parasitic element that has been configured on the top surface of the patch strip with MA4SPS402-PIN diodes. These PIN diodes have generated the switchable polarization in the radiation pattern. The significant design parameters have been analysed and compared with the standard measurements of the anechoic chamber and VNA analyser. Therefore, it has been achieved to have a less than 3 dB axial ratio in a polarized pattern. The proposed reconfigured slot antennas are perfectly suited for interference mitigation in crowded electromagnetic environments having average VSWR of 2.1dB at 3GHz. The reconfigurable MPA characteristics is 1.34 to 1.72 dB VSWR measurement It mitigates interference caused by coexisting systems on the aircraft. Hence, these proposed reconfigured slot antennas have been justified with standard design parameters.

articleTitle: Model Construction of Enterprise Business Portrait Based on Cluster Analysis and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This study delves into the influence of different operation modes on enterprise performance metrics. Employing the K-means clustering algorithm, enterprises were categorized into five distinct groups: marketing-led, product development-led, balanced, research and development-led, and customer service-led. The research unveiled that each operation mode exhibited unique performance outcomes, underscoring the significance of strategic alignment in enterprise operations. The product development-led group showcased the highest average revenue growth, emphasizing the positive correlation between emphasizing product development and financial success. Meanwhile, the research and development-led group demonstrated the highest average profit margin, highlighting the importance of investing in research and innovation for profitability. The customer service-led group achieved the highest customer satisfaction score, underscoring the value of prioritizing customer service in enhancing customer experiences. Additionally, the balanced group boasted the highest employee retention rate, showcasing the importance of a holistic approach to operations in retaining talent. These findings emphasize that strategic focus in specific operational areas can lead to significant benefits in corresponding performance metrics. The study not only contributes insights into the impact of different operation modes on performance but also opens up avenues for future research. Future investigations may delve into specific strategies within each operation mode, explore the impact of external factors, and consider the dynamic nature of operation modes in evolving business landscapes.

articleTitle: ANN Model for Designing Stub Microstrip LowPass Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Using neural network technology, the design technology of the stubbed microstrip low-pass filter is given. The required length of the microstrip filter is used to obtain the correlation between inputs in the neural network. This article presents the design and analysis of stub microstrip low-pass filter with cut-off frequency of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.48\text{GHz}$</tex> with insertion loss (S21) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-3{\text{dB}}$</tex>, and a return loss of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-2.59{\text{dB}}$</tex>. Then, a neural network model was designed to find the difference in the irregularity (S-parameters) of the microstrip low-pass filter with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.48\text{GHz}$</tex> range for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{L}$</tex>-band applications. After the neural model of the microstrip low-pass filter was developed, its design was shown to be more feasible and precise as compared to simulation software. MATLAB programming language and industrial software, IE3D 14.1, are utilized to train the neural network for obtaining precise dimensions after performing simulation.

articleTitle: Fitness Information Synchronization (FIS) Algorithm and Kalman Filter Based Under Water Target Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The localization of nodes in the underwater geographical condition is a vital part of Wireless Sensor Networks in the Water (UWSNs).UWSN helps in several ways oceanic explorations. The localization of nodes suffers a large imbalance due to uncertainty in oceanic conditions. So, this work focuses on enhancing the localization of nodes using fusion and Kalman filter. In this work, the fusion is done between two nodes' data which are the node's age of information and fitness factor nodes. The estimation is done using Fitness Information Synchronization (FIS) Algorithm. The localization process is tried to enhance by calculating the localization error between the actual and estimated position, and the deviation from the actual position. The simulation process is done on a MATLAB simulator. It is observed that the localization error decreases with the increase in time while the deviation from the actual position increases with time. Therefore, it is observed that there is a trade-off between these two constrained.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Local Binary Pattern-based Face Recognition System on Open CV using Boosted Cascade of Simple Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Face recognition has grabbed the interest of biometrics, pattern recognition, and computer vision scientists. Face detection in photos has grown more significant during the last 10 years. Using OpenCV and a boosted cascade of basic features based on Local Binary Pattern (LBP), we created a real-time face recognition system. Pre-processing the photographs improves their quality and normalizes them. You may wish to resize the photographs to a uniform size, convert them to grayscale, and do any other preparatory procedures that are required. Replace file locations and parameters with values appropriate to your dataset and project structure. The pre-processing step involves segmentation, filtering, thresholding, and picture quality enhancement. The BCSF Technique Face recognition is a critical stage in the recognition process. A Faces Database Each face in the database comprises an RTLBP computation and a correlation. The identity vectors in the covariance matrix are derived using a collection of fingerprint photos. Metrics of Performance The recognition method takes 10.18 seconds and has a 99.93% success rate. Face Recognition and Annotation on Multiple Faces Several faces can be recognized and annotated in a single run using traditional approaches. The detector runs in real-time at a frame rate of fifteen frames per second. It is not dependent on visual differences or skin color recognition. The name of the identified individual is shown in the upper left corner of a highlighted rectangle enclosing the face. Methods Evaluation summarizes the benefits and drawbacks of common strategies. This article looks into a variety of novel facial recognition systems.

articleTitle: An enhanced digital control loop of Boost converter in Low Power Microcontrollers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper investigates a customized digital control loop for a Boost DC-DC converter, employing fractional clock cycles to precisely modulate inductor current ramp-up (ton) time and ramp-down (toff) time. The approach involves generating fractional ton time from the last clock cycle of the same ton pulse by using an inverter chain as a delay element, resulting in a 15% enhancement in load current capacity at lower peak inductor currents. Additionally, it streamlines inductor negative current correction, seamlessly adapting to changes in inverter delay that impact both ton and toff times. This scheme is implemented in 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Robot Vision Navigation in Precision Agriculture: Crop Planting and Intelligent Fertilization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Precision agriculture (PA) is an important component of agricultural modernization development. Traditional crop planting and fertilization are mainly done manually, which has strong subjectivity and is difficult to achieve precise grasp. In order to improve the accuracy of crop planting and fertilization, and improve the level of crop production, this article conducts in-depth research on the application of robot vision navigation in PA crop planting and intelligent fertilization. This article first analyzes the concept of PA and the challenges faced by crop planting and fertilization. Then, a robot vision navigation system is constructed, and based on the system, crop and farmland image samples are preprocessed and segmented. Finally, a navigation path is generated. To verify the application effect of robot visual navigation in PA, this article takes a certain agricultural product production area as the experimental environment, and takes corn, potatoes, and peanuts as the objects. The experimental analysis is conducted from two aspects: the positioning accuracy of crop planting navigation and the fertilization effect of the system. The results showed that compared with traditional manual methods, the average nutrient utilization rates of corn, potatoes, and peanuts increased by 9.29%, 9.56%, and 9.21%, respectively, after using robot vision navigation systems to assist intelligent fertilization. The conclusion indicates that robot visual navigation can effectively improve the scientific nature of crop planting and fertilization, and contribute to improving the quality and level of PA production.

articleTitle: MIMO-SAR Image Reconstruction Experiment Using Back-Projection Algorithm with Automotive Radar for ADAS Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging has numerous uses in surface mapping, civil infrastructure, remote sensing, and terrain monitoring. Despite the benefits of multiple input multiple outputs (MIMO) in automotive radars, they are primarily used to provide range, azimuth, and elevation information for automotive applications. Obtaining acceptable angular resolution for automotive radar is a recurring difficulty due to vehicle-to-vehicle, vehicle-to-ground, vehicle-to-guardrail, and vehicle-to-tunnel discrimination. The purpose of this work is to demonstrate MIMO-SAR for finer angular resolution utilizing the 77-GHz Texas Instruments (TI) frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) AWR1642 radar. SAR and MIMO radar topologies are used to increase synthetic or virtual aperture while maintaining adequate angular resolution. SAR is used to rebuild images from experimental data, and the images are created using a backpropagation algorithm. The findings are presented for SAR, MIMO, and MIMO-SAR. Furthermore, the experimental demonstration of MIMO-SAR using 77 GHz automobile radar verifies the prior modeling results. In addition, MIMO-SAR has been shown to provide better angular resolution than SAR and MIMO approaches. This algorithm's superior performance makes it appropriate for the automotive industry to perform SAR imaging on ego-corner deployed short-range radars (SRR) to picture guard rails, crossing vehicles, and VRUs.

articleTitle: Driver's Seat Belt Detection Using CNN-SVM: A Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Seat belt detection is essential in transportation systems to reduce accidents. A seat belt can prevent the driver from fatal injuries. Because the seat belt is a major safety feature inside the vehicle the driver did not give much importance to the seat belt as a safety feature. But seat belts can save the lives of drivers and passengers in more than 40-50% cases of vehicle accidents. We are using a lot of new technology such as sensor-based but they are not very effective in increasing the number of vehicle users with a seat belt. Current technology for generating remainder for seat belts has many shortcomings, It can easily be fooled by using a Seat belt warning stopper or we can buckle the seat belt under the arm. We propose a new technique to detect through the image of the driver and this technique is called a hybrid CNN-SVM classifier for a seat belt. In this technique, the image has a buckled seat belt in the front of the driver's position inside the vehicle. Convolution Neural Network is basically a deep Neural Network. SVM is used as a binary classifier to increase the model's accuracy. In this case, we use CNN to the extraction of features and classify images SVM (Support Vector Machine) is used for the classification of images. We obtained 98.50% accuracy which is more than other traditional or pre-trained models.

articleTitle: Design of Improved Communication System for Indian Railways by using Power Line Carrier Communication (PLCC) System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper has realized the very essential gap in the Indian Railways (IR) communication system and focuses on its fulfilment i.e. direct transmission of passenger or goods locomotive or moving train-related data and sensory information, encompassing details like position, velocity, and vibration parameters, as well as environmental data such as weather conditions, and network-specific information like the number of interconnected trains. Analysing this data enables the implementation of effective policies to reduce maintenance costs, optimize maintenance schedules, and ensure the safe and proper operation of the network and transmit to the divisional control room & nearby station while enabling the complete control of the locomotive from the control room and propose the designing of a more centralized system of communication and control. Calculation of parameters such as frequency and harmonics by simulating the actual line parameters with related mathematical modelling and simulation required.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Harvesting from a Multistring Photovoltaic (PV) Generator using the Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This article proposes an efficient centralized global maximum power tracking (GMPPT) algorithm for multistring photovoltaic (PV) systems operating under partial shading conditions. Multistring configuration is considered the most effective solution due to its advantages in terms of system availability, reliability, and energy efficiency. However, the presence of dedicated DC-DC converters and maximum power search algorithms for each substring increases system cost and complexity. The proposed algorithm utilizes the artificial bee colony (ABC) optimization approach to determine optimal duty cycles, enabling the extraction of the global maximum power from each substring. Notably, the proposed approach significantly reduces the required number of sensors to only one pair of current and voltage sensors, located at the common point of connection for all PV strings. Simulation studies carried out in MATLAB/Simulink platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm under various shading patterns. The proposed ABC-based MPPT algorithm is Overall, the results highlight the efficiency and robust tracking capability of the proposed approach for multistring PV systems.

articleTitle: Exploration on Digital Reconstruction of Spatial Field under Mobile Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the spatial domain digitization, traditional physical field analysis methods cannot accurately describe the three-dimensional topological structure and perform geometric reconstruction, while mobile internet technology achieves information transmission and control through wireless channels. Therefore, this article analyzed it. The rapid development of mobile internet technology has made digital reconstruction of spatial fields a topic worth discussing. This article aimed to explore the relevant theories and practices of digital reconstruction of spatial fields in mobile internet technology, in order to gain a deeper understanding of digital technology. This article mainly applied survey methods and case analysis methods to analyze the field of family space. This article explored the application of mobile internet in the spatial field and proposes digital reconstruction of the spatial field. Survey data showed that at home, the average frequency of people accessing the internet in the living room reached 22%; the average frequency of internet access in the bedroom reached 26%, and the frequency of internet access in other spaces reached 8%.

articleTitle: Review of Regional Photovoltaic Power Dispatching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The stable operation of the power system is crucial for ensuring smooth social production. However, the regional photovoltaic power dispatching faces various challenges, including limited intelligence, unstable power generation, and unpredictable power loads. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the research conducted in this field. It begins by analyzing the research background of regional photovoltaic power dispatching. Subsequently, it introduces algorithm models and typical applications of artificial intelligence technology in regional photovoltaic power generation forecasting, regional power load forecasting, and regional power automatic dispatching systems. Furthermore, the paper highlights the current challenges faced in this field and presents its future prospects. By reading this paper, readers will gain a quick and systematic understanding of the regional photovoltaic power dispatching technology based on artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Efficient Multicore Computing and High-Precision Arithmetic: A Comprehensive Guide to Multicore and Big Number Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Today system and application programming is moving toward concurrent and parallel programming with the development of multicore and multiprogramming architectures. In an effort to improve study performance, researchers are looking for more efficient methods to include multiprocessing and multicore programming into their simulation systems. This article provides an overview of multicore programming and illustrates how it can be implemented. The paper also focusing the limitations of primitive data types for diverse applications, especially in the context of computer systems. The article delves into the necessity of big numbers and arithmetic on a significant scale. Focusing on C programming, the article showcases the implementation of big numbers, providing scholars with a comprehensive understanding of the concept and its practical realization.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Review Topic Mining Methods: From Word Frequency Statistics to Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Review topic mining involves extracting specific evaluation themes from user-generated reviews by identifying characteristic words, serving as the basis for fine-grained opinion analysis and sentiment recognition within review texts. The rapid identification of latent topics from vast collections of review data has remained a prominent and persistent concern within the field of natural language processing. This paper provides a comprehensive review of research progress in review topic mining, introducing the fundamental concepts of review topic mining. Three distinct approaches to review topic mining are discussed, including review topic mining based on word frequency statistics, review topic mining using topic models, and review topic mining that integrates deep learning models. Particular emphasis is placed on exploring cutting-edge methods within these review topic mining approaches. Finally, an analysis of the development trends of deep learning in the field of natural language processing is presented.

articleTitle: Wheeling Pricing Calculation and Allocation using Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Wheeling pricing calculation and allocation play a vital role in ensuring equitable and efficient utilization of transmission networks in electricity markets. Traditional methods often suffer from limitations due to simplified models and assumptions, leading to suboptimal outcomes. In this research, we propose a novel approach based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to address these challenges. Our objective is to leverage the power of DRL algorithms to learn an optimal wheeling pricing policy that considers dynamic power flows, network congestion, and market conditions. By utilizing historical data and reinforcement learning techniques, our approach aims to maximize system efficiency while ensuring fairness and compliance with regulatory constraints. We present the formulation of the wheeling pricing problem as a reinforcement learning task, defining the state space, action space, and reward function for the DRL agent. Through extensive simulations using realistic power system scenarios, we compare the performance of our DRL-based approach with traditional methods, evaluating metrics such as system efficiency, congestion management, and fairness. We also discuss the computational aspects of implementing DRL for real-time wheeling pricing and highlight practical implementation challenges and regulatory considerations. This research contributes to the field by demonstrating the potential of DRL algorithms by comparing previously well known particle swarm optimization (PSO) based algorithm using IEEE 30 -bus system in improving the accuracy and fairness of wheeling pricing in electricity markets, paving the way for future studies in advanced AI techniques for power system operations and market design.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Tweets Detection Within Twitter Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Social media has transformed into a prominent hub for cyberbullying, particularly impacting the younger demographic. The surge in social networking platforms has led to a corresponding increase in instances of online harassment. The primary objective is to employ machine learning techniques to detect linguistic patterns used by individuals involved in bullying within Twitter messages. By leveraging the Twitter API, which provides extensive access to public data, our goal is to develop a software solution capable of autonomously Recognize occurrences of bullying on the platform. The fusion of social science, computer science, and big data is crucial in overcoming the limitations associated with current methods of examining bullying. This approach seeks to advance our understanding of the issue through innovative interdisciplinary strategies. In future endeavors, our plan involves enhancing the accuracy of the existing Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier by incorporating Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), with the aim of achieving more promising and improved result.

articleTitle: Millimeter Wave Wideband MIMO Antenna for the New Radio Bands
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: For modern wireless communication 5G mmWave bands are the appropriate candidates to cooperate for the high-speed communication due to low latency, high capacity, wide coverage, high spectral efficiency, and low penetration losses. Also, due to more than 1 GHz bandwidth above 10 GHz frequency spectrum leads to the multiband operation and saving of hardware costs. In this paper a wideband compact MIMO antenna with coplanar waveguide feed and additional partial grounds (to connect the components) is designed for the coverage of complete new radio (NR) bands on the substrate of Rogers RT5880 for 5G mmWave applications. Proposed antenna operates in a wide band of 17.58-29.92 GHz (BW = 12.33 GHz) with respect to 2:1 VSWR. In the complete operating band radiation efficiency is 95.9% - 99.68 % and total efficiency is 86.64% - 94.54%. The gain lies between 4.22-6.16 dBi.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Allocation for Energy Efficiency in Fog Cloud Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Fog computing has become the primary computing paradigm for IoT applications as it meets the low-latency needs of the growing number of IoT applications. However, the servers can get overwhelmed due to the high demand for fog resources in several IoT applications. Fog computing complements cloud computing, as it only processes user requests near them. Distributing tasks evenly across all nodes in the fog layer helps achieve optimal task processing. Load balancing in the fog-cloud computing environment aids in diminishing energy use. In this article, fog computing architecture named “EcoFogLoad Architecture” has been proposed to balance the workload among the fog layer. Along with this, the “Energy-Efficient Workload Optimization (EEWO)” algorithm has been proposed to optimize the use of resources at fog layer in terms of cost, time delay and energy consumption. iFogSim has been used to execute the proposed algorithm and obtain the experimental results. The results of the proposed approach are compared with those of other existing algorithms. Load balancing at the fog layer facilitates optimal resource utilization, reducing latency and improving service quality. The article concludes by presenting potential avenues for future research.

articleTitle: Traffic Optimization and Route Detection Based on Air Quality and Pollution Level
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This research outlines the development of a groundbreaking Traffic Optimization and Route Detection system based on pollution and air quality. Urbanization has led to increased vehicular traffic, exacerbating concerns about air pollution and its adverse effects on public health. The proposed system aims to address this critical issue by integrating real-time environmental data into route recommendations, prioritizing routes that minimize exposure to high-pollution areas. Beyond improving air quality, the system promotes the health and well-being of commuters, encourages the adoption of eco-friendly transportation modes, and contributes to overall environmental sustainability. An air quality detection system is developed to gather data for the development of the system. This innovative approach aligns with the goals of efficient urban mobility, sustainable transportation, and data-driven decision-making. Through this research, we anticipate providing valuable insights into the potential impact of integrating pollution and air quality considerations into urban transportation systems, ultimately contributing to healthier and more sustainable urban environments.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The increasing yearly death rates caused by breast cancer, which is the most prevalent kind of cancer and a leading cause of female mortality worldwide, emphasize the urgent requirement for progress in disease prognosis and detection to enhance overall well-being. Attaining a high level of accuracy in cancer prediction is of utmost significance in improving treatment strategies and enhancing patient survival rates. Machine learning (ML) techniques are crucial in improving the accuracy and prior identification of breast cancer. They have become a central focus of study and have shown strong effectiveness. This study applies four machine learning techniques, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision tree, Gaussian Naive Bayes (NB), and K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), to the breast cancer Wisconsin diagnostic dataset. Following the obtained outcomes, a thorough assessment and comparison of the performance of these classifiers were carried out. The primary aim of this study is to utilize ML algorithms to forecast and identify the breast cancer, specifically by establishing the most efficient method based on the confusion matrix, accuracy, and precision. Remarkably, the SVM exhibited superior performance compared to the other models, with an impressive accuracy rate of 96.7%. The studies were performed in the Visual Studio Code environment utilizing the Python programming language and the Scikit-learn module.

articleTitle: Utilizing Artificial Intelligence in Telemedicine for Efficient Remote Diagnosis and Treatment Plan
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: To facilitate dynamic and adaptive remote diagnosis and treatment planning, the “Dynamic Adaptive Diagnosis and Treatment (DADT)” approach uses three fundamental AI algorithms that operate in tandem with one another. The cornerstone is the Intelligent Symptom Analysis Algorithm (ISAA), which uses patient-reported symptoms and medical history to make diagnostic determinations. The Adaptive Treatment Recommender (ATR) algorithm constantly adjusts prescribed treatments considering patient feedback, research findings, and new standards of care. In order to constantly learn from fresh data and update diagnostic and treatment models, the Continuous Learning Diagnostic Network (CLDN) makes use of a neural network. Accurate diagnosis and individualized treatment planning are the goals of the suggested technique, which is intended for use in distant healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mechanical Processing Quality Control System in Networked Manufacturing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of the Internet today, mechanical processing enterprises should not only adapt to new situations, but also reorganize various business processes. This article uses the Web to efficiently integrate internal and external resources of the enterprise, and monitors the network operation of the mechanical processing process. This article is based on object-oriented, distributed computing and other technologies to achieve fast and remote intelligent control of mechanical machining processes. Based on this, an object-oriented CNC machining quality control system is constructed. In the average error statistics of different batches of products, the highest error is 0.8mm, and the overall error is relatively small.

articleTitle: Cyber Attacking Active FMCW Radar Signal AoA Estimation Using Passive FMCW Radar for ADAS Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radars are a popular choice for Advanced Driver Assistant Systems (ADAS) that identify and track objects in the field of view. These mmWave radars (the primary radar on ego vehicles) are susceptible to interference signals from other mmWave radars (secondary radars on traffic participant vehicles) in the vicinity, which can result in false detection and tracking triggers. Knowing the interference signal's angle of arrival (AoA) is critical for locating the secondary radar source. This study discusses the experiments with AoA estimation of interference signals created by secondary radars when the primary radar is in a passive state. We performed a 3-dimensional Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the received I-Q data and used a range-angle heatmap image to determine the signal's spatial pattern. The 3D FFT (range FFT on time-domain ADC samples, velocity FFT on chirps, and angle FFT across antennas) calculates the AoA of the signals. In this experiment, the 77GHz IWR1642 primary radar is in passive mode, while the other 77GHz secondary radars (AWR1642 and AWR2944) are in active mode, providing an interference attack. We also tried with different ranges (2m, 3m, 5m, and 8m) and azimuths to determine the stealthiness of the attack. The AoA for passive radar is a good fit for identifying spurious sources/illuminators of opportunities, electronic counter-countermeasures (ECCM), source localization, knowledge-aided passive radar systems, and cognitive radar development.

articleTitle: Interactive Virtual Simulation Technology in Artistic Lighting Design System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the continuous progress of technology, interactive virtual simulation technology has been widely applied in various fields. Among them, interactive virtual simulation technology is gradually becoming a powerful and effective tool in artistic lighting design systems. The file format customized by the 3ds Max software stores the geometric information of LED lights, and utilizes a graphical user interface for two-dimensional and three-dimensional interaction of lighting. A comparison was made between the number of adjustments and optimizations made by designers using traditional design methods and interactive virtual simulation technology (IVST). The traditional design method had 10 adjustments and 8 optimizations. The IVST has 4 adjustments and 3 optimizations. This method enables designers to visually observe the lighting effect, thereby avoiding time waste caused by blind experimentation and repeated modifications, and facilitating real-time adjustment and optimization of lighting parameters.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Green Traffic Monitoring System Based on Improved Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In response to the current problems of lack of flexibility, insufficient data collection and analysis capabilities, and insufficient environmental friendliness in the design of green traffic monitoring systems, this paper conducted research on green traffic monitoring systems based on the improved Apriori algorithm. As an important means to achieve green transportation, the green traffic monitoring system needs to be able to obtain and process a large amount of traffic data in real-time and accurately. This article utilized the improved Apriori algorithm to design the system, which enhanced the traffic monitoring system. The real-time information transmission design and traffic flow monitoring module were thoroughly studied, improving the accuracy and efficiency of system monitoring. The results showed that the accuracy of vehicle speed monitoring in the system designed based on the improved Apriori algorithm was above 96.8%. After 20 experiments, the average accuracy of vehicle speed monitoring was 98.01%. The green traffic monitoring system based on improved Apriori algorithm can effectively mine association rules in traffic data, providing scientific and accurate decision-making basis for traffic management departments.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems Considering Green Certificates and Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the context of “Peak Carbon and Carbon Neutral” goal, the existing reward and punishment carbon trading model interacts with dynamic demand response to better reflect the low-carbon attributes of new energy sources, and helps to improve the realization mechanism of clean substitution in the integrated energy system. The article constructs the dynamic demand response modelling in the IES of the park considering various types of dynamic demand response, and proposes a green dispatching method of the integrated energy system that realises the linkage between the carbon ladder trading model and the green certificate market. First, the paper introduces the operation principle and interaction mechanism of green certificate trading and reward and punishment carbon trading price model. Secondly, dynamic modelling of multiple kinds of dynamic demand response with the objective of lowest cost. Finally, the results of the examples in different scenarios show that the proposed approach in this article is both economical as well as lowcarbon, improving the clean energy utilisation of this system.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Electric City Bus Power System Based on Multi-objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Pure electric vehicles are a new type of electric vehicle with great development potential, but they still face many challenges in terms of range and dynamic characteristics, such as small battery capacity, slow charging rate, poor safety, and serious secondary pollution. This article used ADVISOR (Advanced Vehicle Simulator) to model the entire vehicle, wheels, reducer, and battery. On this basis, by establishing a complete vehicle model, this paper proposed a new design method for the driving system of electric city buses based on multi-objective genetic algorithm. This article studied the theoretical basis of multi-objective optimization problems to determine the optimization design variables, optimization objective functions, and required constraints. The designed vehicle model was parameterized and optimized, ultimately determining the optimal driving system component parameter combination scheme. Through comparison with before and after optimization, it was found that pure electric vehicles have significantly improved energy efficiency and power performance. The specific energy consumption of electric city buses has decreased from 0.098 kWh/km*t to 0.096 kWh/km*t. This article verified that the various performance indicators of the established vehicle model met the design requirements, thereby proving that the parameter matching design of the designed car is reasonable and correct.

articleTitle: UVM Based Verification of an Ethernet MAC using Wishbone Bus
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Ethernet is a wired computer networking technology used for connecting computer to another digital device. It is standardized as IEEE 802.3, which has been improved to accommodate faster data transfers with more nodes and longer network with longer networking length while retaining a significant amount of compatibility. Ethernet is specified for certain speeds of operation from 1Mb/s to 400Gb/s using a common media access control (MAC) specification. The carrier sense multiple access with collision detection (CSMA/CD) protocol specifies shared medium full duplex and half duplex. The wishbone bus, master used for sending data into memory and slave used for getting data from the memory. Ethernet MAC with wishbone Master and Slave interface is used to check the functionality using System Verilog Environment (OOPS) and UVM (Universal Verification Methodology).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Android-based Intelligent Archive System for Talent Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the popularization of mobile internet, smartphones have become an indispensable tool in people's lives. In order to adapt to the development of the times, universities have also developed mobile application software. Talent cultivation is an important component of teaching work in universities and plays a crucial role in improving teaching quality. The article was based on the Android platform to design and implement an intelligent talent cultivation file system, which realized functions such as attendance management, score query, class ranking, and exam score analysis for students, and tested and optimized the system. The experimental results showed that the system had high processing efficiency (Max: 94.7%) and short response time (Min: 196ms), which could more effectively provide technical support for students and teachers.

articleTitle: Area And Speed-Efficient Vedic RISC Processors for Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper provides the architecture for high -speed multiplication using one of the Vedic arithmetic approaches. This strategy is used to increase speed. The compressor-based multiplier outperforms other stranded techniques like array and booth in terms of speed and space. Efficient multiplication is critical in computer design, particularly in DSPs where signal processing is a primary responsibility. The CPU is compact and efficient, making it suitable for usage in small-scale embedded systems or IoT nodes. The Vedic Arithmetic and Logical Unit (ALU) refers to the use of Vedic mathematical ideas for arithmetic operations. This option may aid in making mathematical computations faster and more efficient. For simulation, the Xilinx ISE tool is used, which is often used for FPGA design. This procedure facilitates the verification of the design's functionality and performance before actual hardware implementation. Because of their flexibility and reconfigurability, FPGAs are perfect for prototyping and deploying customized CPUs.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an IoT-Enabled Smart Egg Incubator with Light Intensity Control for Enhanced Hatching Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper an advanced egg incubation system is represented. It will automatically control the inside environment of the incubator by maintaining requisite temperature and humidity throughout the hatching process. The internal environmental status of the incubator can be monitored from remote location with the use of WiFi. Heat is generated inside the incubator using incandescent bulbs. For accurate control of the internal temperature the bulb illumination is controlled using ac dimmer module. Thus, frequent switching on and off of the relay circuit for varying temperature can be avoided. This will further help in reduction of the transient spike generation due to switching on and off. The core of this proposed system lies in the utilization of the ESP32 controller for remote monitoring and autonomous regulation of internal temperature and humidity. Additionally, a local OLED display is integrated into the hardware to provide on-site readings of temperature and humidity. The incubation process involves a specially designed turner equipped with a low-speed propeller. This turner ensures the uniform distribution of heat and moisture to the eggs Temperature control is dynamically managed within this proposed method, optimizing conditions for the ideal incubation environment. For the uses having no access to the internet facility, another hardware prototype is also developed, where there is a local monitoring and automatic control of the internal environment of the incubator is done. The proposed system has been developed as a functional hardware prototype, which underwent testing with multiple egg sets to confirm its effectiveness. The results have demonstrated a high level of hatching accuracy. This research marks a major stride in smart egg incubation technology, promising improved efficiency and outcomes in the field of poultry farming.

articleTitle: Indoor Fire and Smoke Detection Using Soft-Voting Based Deep Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Fire and smoke detection using vision-based technology plays a crucial role in terms of safety for indoor environments. In the literature, there are several deep learning-based fire detection solutions available, but most of the existing solutions suffer from low accuracy, high false alarm rates, and vanishing gradient issues. To overcome these issues, this paper proposed a soft-voting based deep ensemble model for fire and smoke detection tasks in which four transfer learning models such as MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB0, and DenseNet121 are used as base learners. The proposed model has a 99.11% accuracy rate, a 97% precision rate, a 98% recall rate, and a 98% F1-score.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Wideband mmW Wearable Antenna with Asymmetries in Circular Patch for n258 K-Band
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Variety of planar antennas have been reported in last two decades for the millimeter wave applications. Due to high metal and dielectric losses most of the 4G laminates are limited in use for 5G trans-receive operations. In the proposed research, a compact circularly polarized single input single output (SISO) antenna with asymmetries in circular patch is designed for n258 (24.25 – 27.5 GHz) 5G mmWave band. The antenna with multiple sectoral slots at different angles and half-moon shaped slot is designed on Rogers 5880 substrate of size 21.65 × 18.71 × 0.508 metre cube. The proposed antenna covers the 2:1 VSWR frequency band of 22.38 – 27.50 GHz and axial ratio band of 23.98 – 25.59 GHz. The operating bandwidth is 5.12 GHz and the axial ratio bandwidth is 1.62 GHz. The presented design achieves gain of more than 5.7 dBi and more than 950% radiation efficiency in band. The maximum value of the gain in band is 7.94 dBi.

articleTitle: Design of Composite Factor Variance and Component Analysis System Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: It is very difficult to analyze and mine massive and high-dimensional data. Although the current hardware conditions have greatly improved, they still cannot meet the needs of large-scale, high-dimensional data. In medical research, scientific experiments, and biological gene sequencing, a combination of analysis of variance and principal component analysis was used to study the above issues. On this basis, this article started from two main data analysis methods and studied the relevant theories and algorithms of binary analysis of variance and principal component analysis, in order to achieve the analysis of sample data. The experiment proved that the data analysis based on the system in this article can combine the factor load matrix of the main factor variables to evaluate the contribution of each factor in the investment portfolio to the overall risk. Finally, the optimal stock portfolio was 601989, 601601, 600028, 600104, 601857, and 601988.

articleTitle: Application of Fast Generation Algorithm in Motion Prediction Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In diversified and large-scale motion data forecasting, traditional forecasting methods often lack effective handling of complex changes, diversified changes, sudden factors, and dynamic changes, resulting in unsatisfactory accuracy and timeliness of forecasting results. This article proposed and studied a motion prediction analysis system based on fast generation algorithms. The fast generation algorithm has shown significant advantages in generating, filtering, modeling, and dynamic prediction in large-scale motion data due to its excellent dynamic processing ability, ability to handle complex problems, and advantage in real-time feedback. By verifying the relative error of predicting athlete heart rate load, the highest error in this article was 0.32%, and the lowest error was 0.11%; the highest error of heuristic algorithms was 8.73%, and the lowest error was 1.34%; the maximum error of traditional algorithms was 13,53%, and the minimum error was 3.56%. Compared to traditional algorithms and heuristic algorithms, the motion prediction analysis system based on fast generation algorithms had efficient prediction performance, and had significant advantages in the accuracy and speed of motion prediction. The optimization of sports forecasting analysis has a positive impact on athlete training and guidance.

articleTitle: Applied Research of Agricultural Quadruped Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Four-legged robots are more and more widely used, especially in agriculture. Four-legged robots can not only be used for various agricultural tasks, but also be equipped with various sensors and equipment to collect and analyze farmland data to help farmers make scientific decisions and improve the efficiency and quality of agricultural production. In order to make the quadruped robot better serve agriculture, the system composition, software and hardware design of the robot are important. This paper introduces in detail the design and implementation of the mechanical, circuit and software parts of the quadruped robot. For the motion control of the single joint of the robot, a joint servo controller integrating DC motor motion control and driving is designed. The hardware adopts Raspberry Pi 4B, MG996R steering gear, PCA9685 steering gear drive board, KCD-11 ship switch, MP24825V5A step-down module, aircraft-mode lithium battery 7.4V 2200mAH and a variety of sensors. Experimental test results show that the designed quadruped robot has stable structure and good performance, which is more suitable for complex and dangerous environments.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Multi-Band Slotted Patch Antenna for Various Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: We have developed and analyzed a triple-band slotted trapezoidal shape patch antenna with a focus on compact dimensions (36 mm × 36 mm × 1.6 mm). This antenna operates across triple resonant microwave frequency bands to cater to diverse wireless applications, including Mobile Broadband Wireless Access (MBWA) protocols based on standards specifications such as IEEE 802.20 (1.6–2.3 GHz), WiMAX (3.02–4.68 GHz), WLAN (5.8 GHz), IoT protocol ISM band (4.33 GHz) and X-band (5.10-15.22 GHz). The design features a slotted trapezoidal-shaped radiating patch and a trapezoidal-shaped partial ground section implemented on an FR-4 dielectric substrate material. The antenna successfully achieves the multi-band configuration, supported by simulated results demonstrating favorable return loss, radiation patterns, gain, and radiation efficiency. The stability of the simulated results is maintained across the achieved resonating modes

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Penta-band Slotted Microstrip Patch Antenna for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A penta-band slotted patch antenna, featuring a octagonal shape, is developed and analysed with a primary emphasis on compactness, measuring 37 mm × 22 mm × 1.6 mm. This antenna is engineered to operate across five distinct microwave frequency bands, catering to a wide array of wireless applications. These include S band WiMAX (3.5 GHz – IEEE 802.16e), C band WLAN (5.0 GHz – IEEE 802.11j, 5.8 GHz – IEEE 802.11a), 5G NR bands (n77 – 3.3 to 4.2 GHz, n78 – 3.3 to 3.8 GHz, n79 – 4.4 to 5.0 GHz, n46 – 5.15 to 5.925 GHz, n47 – 5.855 to 5.925 GHz), X band (8 to 12 GHz – Radar, space communication, terrestrial broadband, amateur radio applications), Lower K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">U</inf> band (12.53 to 14.98 GHz – satellite communication), Lower K band (17.76 to 18.91 GHz – astronomical observations), and Middle K band (19.77 to 22.01 GHz – molecular rotational spectroscopy). The antenna design incorporates a slotted radiating patch and a partial ground section adopting a rectangular shape, fabricated on an FR-4 dielectric substrate material. This configuration enables the antenna to effectively operate across multiple bands, as confirmed by simulated results showcasing favourable return loss, radiation patterns, gain, and radiation efficiency. The stability of these simulated results persists across the resonating modes attained by the antenna.

articleTitle: Network Design and Optimization of Logistics Supply Chain Based on Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the growth of global trade and the intensification of market competition, the importance of logistics supply chain has become increasingly prominent. However, the traditional logistics supply chain is facing many problems in terms of operating efficiency, operating cost and service quality. Therefore, this paper proposes a logistics supply chain network design method based on the optimal strategy, and compares the designed logistics network with the traditional logistics network to find out its advantages. And on this basis, this paper proposes an improvement plan to improve system efficiency, reduce system cost, and improve system service quality. The research purpose of this thesis is to discuss how to use the optimal algorithm to design and optimize the logistics supply chain network. Optimizing the logistics supply chain can greatly improve the operating efficiency of the enterprise, and at the same time enable the enterprise to better adapt to the needs of customers. This is of great practical significance to enhance the competitiveness of Chinese enterprises and promote the sustainable development of our country's economy and society.

articleTitle: Advancing Digital Design: Integration of 16-Bit Unsigned Divider Capability in Xilinx's Kintex and Virtex FPGA Chips for Enhanced Computational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The addition of a 16-bit unsigned divider to Xilinx's Kintex and Virtex FPGA devices improves digital design and computational performance. Developers may divide nonnegative 16-bit integers with the 16-bit unsigned divider for precision numerical operations. Due to their hardware versatility and efficiency, FPGAs may speed complicated algorithms in numerous application industries. Recognizable logic gates and programmable interconnects make FPGAs versatile for digital signal processing, telecommunications, and fast prototyping. Xilinx's Kintex and Virtex series, known for customized designs and outstanding performance, get a 16-bit unsigned divider capability. Engineers may execute complex algorithms faster and more precisely with this innovation, opening up new possibilities in embedded systems, telecommunications, and more. Using HDLs like Verilog and VHDL makes FPGA programming easy, like software. When efficiency and speed are crucial, FPGAs are essential in highperformance computing and real-time processing. Xilinx's Kintex and Virtex FPGA processors' 16-bit unsigned divider integration marks a major FPGA technical milestone. It simplifies calculation and widens digital designs, enabling designers to reach new possibilities. In this development, Xilinx's dedication to cutting-edge solutions shows how FPGAs are becoming essential tools for a wide range of applications. Xilinx, FPGA, 16-bit unsigned division, computational efficiency, digital design, hardware acceleration, and highperformance computing are keywords for this work.

articleTitle: Impact of Water Pollutants in River Narmada Using RapidMiner Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Rivers are drying up and becoming more contaminated for a variety of causes, which is extremely bad for the environment and all living things. It is getting worse for the environment and the next generation of humans that species are disappearing and that habitats are being lost because of human activity. Large-scale pollution of the River Narmada has become a major issue for all. In Hinduism, the Narmada River is considered sacred. Given the alarming rate at which pollution is growing, it will be challenging for us to preserve our holy Narmada. An attempt has been made to identify the factors polluting the Narmada river, in this research. The Government Open Dataset and online forums are just two of the places where the research data was gathered. The data mining approach is used for the analysis, which involves extracting hidden and valuable information that is difficult to find. The dataset is mined in order to identify the reasons. RapidMiner is an open-source software platform, extensively used to execute data mining. The Naive Bayes Classifier is used to categorize the factors of pollution. As the predictions are created to identify the impact of the pollutants on the basis of provided pollution factors, the data is trained and tested, respectively, to verify the accuracy of the system. The causes of pollution and workable remedies are discussed in the paper's conclusion.

articleTitle: DCHR: Dynamic Cluster Head Replacement Algorithm for Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: One of the major aspects for sensing solutions across diverse applications, is the demand associated with better lifetime of sensor nodes. This can be resolved using energy optimization of these nodes in Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). The energy consumption level for certain nodes may not be the same and therefore, it may die earlier than its expectation. In WSN, the critical challenge lies in efficiently managing the finite energy resources of sensor nodes to ensure prolonged network operation and transmission success. In this paper, we present a dynamic cluster head replacement algorithm (DCHR) that calculates a threshold value in determining the number of rounds for a particular sensor as active cluster head (CH). This depends on the remaining energy left with the battery of that particular node. This algorithm helps in reduction of energy consumption during next replacement of CH and ultimately results in overall lifetime of WSN.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy-Driven Microgrid Design for a Desalination Plant in Noakhali, Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The scarcity of drinking water is a threat to the survival of any living being. The sea is the largest source of water, yet this source remains unutilized due to salinity. Production of drinking water from sea water using reverse osmosis (RO) desalination is viable using modern technology. This paper proposes a solar powered microgrid system for desalination plants with a capacity of 100 cubic meter per day drinking water located in Noakhali. The optimal solution for microgrid design is based on the criteria of energy costs, meeting demand requirements, and limiting excess electricity, utilizing HOMER. The optimal design includes 170 kW of solar panels, meeting the target energy demand for the RO plant. The predicted reduction of around 100 tons of carbon dioxide emissions by the proposed microgrid has a favorable effect on the environment.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Target Detection System Based on Multi-Scale Network and Planning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Based on the dynamic planning algorithm, this paper proposes an in-depth analysis of the motion process based on multi-scale network and video. This application solves the functional problem that the existing sports APP pays more attention to teaching courses, but ignores the analysis of users' personalised sports. Through the simulation experiment results, the problem of false alarming target points around the target has been successfully reduced. The study also focusses on the use of dynamic programming energy indicators with linear predictors, which significantly reduces energy diffusion and provides important support for subsequent trajectory association detection. In the research, the article investigates the application of multi-scale network in image processing.

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning Based Approach for Alzheimer's Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a degenerative neurological condition that impairs cognitive function and awareness in humans. It has a direct impact on the development of cognitive capacity and brain function. The incidence of Alzheimer's disease is progressively increasing, especially among persons aged 60 and older, finally resulting in mortality. It disrupts nearly all cognitive processes that the brain can perform. Over time, this leads to a reduction in brain size and volume. At now, there is no known therapy capable of reversing the neurological deterioration caused by Alzheimer's disease. Prompt recognition of symptoms is essential for enabling early detection and therapy. Over the years, extensive study has been carried out on the utilization of machine learning for the diagnosis and categorization of Alzheimer's disease. This research proposes a transfer learning-based approach that utilizes the VGG-16 deep learning architecture. The proposed framework offers a method for categorizing AD, consisting of the following steps: For data input, import the pre-trained VGG-16 model and exclude the fully linked layers. Revise the current fully connected layers or introduce new ones to align with the objective of classifying Alzheimer's disease. Implement weight freezing on the initial layers and do fine-tuning on the model using the OASIS dataset to tailor it for the specific characteristics of brain MRI scans. Divide the dataset into training, validation, and test sets. Continue the training process of the updated model using the training dataset. Monitor the model's performance on the validation set and adjust hyperparameters accordingly. The model's performance is assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score as metrics on the OASIS datasets. The proposed method has achieved an accuracy of 94.4%, a precision of 90%, a recall of 99.9%, and an F1 score of 95%.

articleTitle: Recommendation System of Tourist Attractions Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
