Moreover, it is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1.67}\times$</tex> times faster during read operation and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1.15}\times$</tex> times faster during write operation. The static noise margin during hold, read and write operation is improved by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1.01}\times \boldsymbol{1.94}\times$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1.05}\times$</tex> respectively, compared to conventional 6T bit-cell. The BLE10T cell and conventional 6T cell are simulated at 45nm technology node using cadence virtuoso simulator.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of Different MPPT Algorithms for Thermoelectric Generator Optimization: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Thermoelectric Generator (TEG) is an essential semiconductor gadget that give rise to electrical current for voltage devices by converting heat flow and the hotness difference between two edges of the Thermoelectric Generator device. Conventionally, a Thermoelectric Generator is useful for small power utilization. When the electrical load matches with the inner resistance of the Thermoelectric Generator, it generates topmost power. However, coordination with impedance cannot be sure in every circumstance. As a consequence, Thermoelectric Generator (TEG) serve at lesser efficiency. Due to these consequences, different maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms are practiced. In this suggested task we modeled the Thermoelectric Generator (TEG) system and simulated the system with two different MPPT algorithms. This task mainly highlights the making use of waste heat generated from various spots like automotive exhaust, bakehouse, kitchen oven, pastry shop, hot water pipes, solar photovoltaic (PV) panels, body heats, etc. which commonly is not taken into deliberation. The proposed model is combined with three different parts of constituent particularly the thermoelectric Generator (TEG), charge controller and load. The entire specimen has been authenticated through MATLAB Simulinkbased software results. The topmost power from the TEG is acquired actively by perturb and observe ( P&O) and variable fractional order Fuzzy logic (VFOLC) maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms.

articleTitle: Framework for Spectral Analysis of Resonance Patterns in Quality Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: We have considered a network topology of several types of weights to describe the dynamical properties of the real environments. In this study, we adopt the red wine quality problem as a case study of it and develop an experimental model using a publicly available dataset. An objective and quantitative approach is needed to assess wine quality. This is because sensory testing, known as tasting, is influenced by the winemaking process, grape origin, barrel type and ageing period, as well as the flavor profile of a particular grape variety. Modelling and spectral analysis is conducted by assigning inter-agent weights to each parameter related to wine quality, using the typical graph of star topologies that have been studied. The obtained resonance patterns of eigenvectors are decoded in this paper. The impact of each parameter on wine quality is analyzed across factors to identify the parameter that improve wine quality. The eigenvalues and eigenvectors obtained from the model are used in this paper to investigate resonance patterns. In our previous work, the largest and smallest eigenvalues have been the main focus of analysis. In this paper, we adopt the analysis of resonance patterns of eigenvectors in order to cross-sectionally evaluate factors contributing to wine quality improvement. We present a framework to identify the fundamental laws governing quality dynamics.

articleTitle: Efficient THD Mitigation and Enhanced Output in Single-Phase 5-Level Inverters: A Variable Frequency PWM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This brief discusses modulation techniques for harmonic deformation and amplification of output side voltage in multilevel inverters. The operation of cascaded H-Bridge converters through simulation with the help of level shift PWM, can be divided into 3 different parts that are PD, POD and APOD. These are used for single-phase phase 5-level cascaded multilevel inverter. Multilevel inverters represent power-electronics utilization of uninterruptible power supplies as well as active power filters. Variable Frequency PWM methods have been applied in a cascaded H-bridge multilevel converter in DC microgrid. This technique is being used for multilevel inverters in DC microgrid to evaluate the performance parameter and it is being used to link through various forms of carrier-based PWM procedures such as POD, PD, APOD, PSC and TTMC PWM techniques. The necessary elements of output voltage as well as THD will be considered as a complete breakdown of the result that has been derived and studied. The simulation has been achieved for a cascaded multilevel inverter with the help of MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Design of Autonomous Learning and Communication Platform based on Interpretable Personalized Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for personalized access to items and information, the application of recommendation systems has become increasingly widespread. As a mechanism that can provide explanation of recommendation results, interpretable personalized recommendation systems are gradually being valued by more and more people. To verify the effectiveness of interpretable personalized recommendation systems, this study designed an autonomous learning communication platform and conducted experiments using traditional recommendation algorithms and interpretable personalized recommendation algorithms based on user behavior analysis. When designing an autonomous learning and communication platform, the focus was on user privacy protection, interpretability, and performance accuracy. The platform collected user behavior data such as browsing, liking, commenting, and collecting articles, and used traditional algorithms and interpretable personalized recommendation algorithms based on user behavior analysis to recommend articles to users. In addition, the platform also provided a recommendation explanation function, allowing users to view the reasons for the recommendation and better understand the recommendation results. In the experiment, three indicators, namely average accuracy, average coverage, and average trust, were used to compare traditional algorithms with interpretable algorithms. The results showed that compared to traditional algorithms, interpretable algorithms have significantly improved average accuracy and average trust, with an average accuracy improvement of 0.13 and an average trust improvement of 0.23. This indicates that interpretable personalized recommendation algorithms based on user behavior analysis relatively better protect user privacy, and the recommendation results are more in line with the personalized needs of users.

articleTitle: Evaluation on English Video Learning System Based on 5G Technology and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Due to historical reasons, English has become the most widely used language in the world, and its high popularity has made it the most widely learned second language. The video learning proposed in this article is a good way to learn English. However, the content of video learning is still too broad, so this article has decided to establish an English video learning system based on 5G technology and neural networks to improve students’ learning patterns. The core idea is to use 5G technology to establish a huge resource library, and use neural networks to analyze students’ behavioral characteristics, in order to promptly correct incorrect behaviors.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Prediction Model Based on Hybrid Model Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation, or solar power generation, is a clean power generation method that is also a highly concerned power generation method under the macro issue of carbon reduction and environmental protection. Monitoring its work efficiency is very important. Therefore, this article believed that establishing a photovoltaic prediction model to predict the work efficiency of photovoltaic power generation equipment can effectively solve this problem. Photovoltaic power generation relies on sunlight, so meteorological factors have a direct impact on its work efficiency. Therefore, this article hoped to consider the impact of meteorological factors on photovoltaic power generation through WRF (Weather Research and Forecasting Model), and design a photovoltaic prediction model that can effectively predict. Moreover, this article also conducted comparative statistics on the relevant indicators of the successfully designed model at the end. The average absolute error of the improved model was only 0.47°C, and the original model was as high as 1.87°C. The improved model achieved a prediction accuracy of 89%, while the original model was only 67%. These fully demonstrated that the improved photovoltaic prediction model based on the hybrid model algorithm in this article was competent for prediction work.

articleTitle: Research on Course Recommendation Algorithm Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of information technology, information resources on the Internet have increased explosively. A variety of online education platforms have also appeared in front of learners, providing learners with sufficient reference materials and learning materials, bringing a lot of convenience. Everything has two sides. The development of information technology not only brings convenience to learners, but also brings a lot of problems to learners. The number of complex learning resources on the Internet leads to too many choices of learners and excessive information, which increases the dropout rate of learners and reduces the passing rate of courses. Therefore, many education platforms use recommendation systems to recommend popular courses, but popular courses are not necessarily suitable for learners, so personalized recommendation systems have emerged. But traditional recommendation system has some problems, sparse data and cold boot, et al. Therefore, it is necessary to use auxiliary information to assist the recommendation system to make course recommendation to alleviate these problems. Therefore, this paper proposes a new model. The model consists of three parts: the left part is the prediction part of the recommender system, the middle part models the left and right two parts using the cross-compression unit, and the right is a good item representing the vector through GCN. Through CTR, we verify the experimental results of AUC, ACC, HR and NDCG, and compare them with other algorithms.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Design of Compact T-Shape Slot and Notch Loaded Dual Band Microstrip Antenna for 5G/WLAN Application in S and C-Band
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this article, a compact and dual band T-shape slot and notch implanted rectangular microstrip antenna using line feed has been presented. The total size of presented antenna is only 30×36×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The design and simulation of this antenna is carried out with IE3D. The designed antenna resonates in dual band at 3.31 GHz with −24.59 dB return loss and 5.08 GHz with −38.45 dB return loss between frequency range 3.14 to 3.48 GHz and 4.77 to 5.37 GHz showing impedance bandwidth 340 MHz (10.27%) and 600 MHz (11.83%) in lower and upper bands respectively. The dual band antenna also shows 4.08 dB and 5.01 dB peak gain while 84% and 85% antenna efficiency at resonating frequencies 3.31 GHz and 5.08 GHz. The presented antenna of dual band is suitable in S-band for 5G and in C-band for WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Speech Recognition System Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and big data technology, the application of intelligent speech recognition system in various fields is gradually expanding. However, traditional intelligent speech recognition systems still have some limitations in terms of user satisfaction, accuracy and speed. In order to overcome the limitations of the traditional intelligent speech recognition system and further improve its performance, this paper introduces an intelligent speech recognition system based on data analysis algorithms. The system utilizes large-scale datasets for training and analysis to improve the recognition accuracy of speech signals and the overall performance of the system. The purpose of this research is to explore the advantages and disadvantages of an intelligent speech recognition system based on data analysis algorithms, and to further improve the performance of the system in noisy environments. This paper adopts the research method of experimental verification, conducts a comprehensive analysis and evaluation of the intelligent speech recognition system based on data analysis algorithm, and puts forward suggestions for improving the algorithm. Research shows that the intelligent speech recognition system based on data analysis algorithm has obvious advantages in terms of user satisfaction, accuracy and speed. However, the system still faces challenges such as noisy environment and false recognition rate. In order to improve the system performance, we need to improve the noise processing algorithm, optimize the algorithm, and increase the training data. Through the research of this paper, we provide useful reference and guidance for the development and application of intelligent speech recognition system.

articleTitle: MindSight: Revolutionizing Brain Tumor Diagnosis with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Brain tumors, characterized by abnormal cell growth, pose a substantial health challenge with non-cancerous (benign) and cancerous (malignant) categories. India witnesses the diagnosis of approximately 40,000 fresh instances of brain tumors annually. The rarity and diversity of tumor types make predicting survival rates challenging. Efficient identification of cerebral abnormalities is essential for the timely and effective management of neurological conditions. Exploring the application of deep learning, this study investigates brain tumor detection using a curated dataset of Magnetic Resonance Images (MRI). Utilizing this dataset, brain tumor detection is advanced through the application of diverse models, including EfficientNetB3, ResNet50, MobileNetV3, and VGG16. The study prioritizes dataset preprocessing, emphasizing data augmentation. Diverse brain tumor images contribute to model training, incorporating transfer learning from pre-trained models on extensive datasets for discerning intricate patterns in medical images. Efficiency evaluation considers computational resources, training time, and complexity. Quantitative metrics F1 score, accuracy, recall, and precision are employed to gauge model performance in classifying the tumor and non-tumor regions. In the conducted study, VGG16 demonstrated the best performance compared to all other models.

articleTitle: Using IoT Optimize different Psychological Problems in Human Brain with the Help of Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: One of the most promising application areas of Internet of Things' (IoT) is healthcare. Humans experience stress, a delicate psycho-physiological state, in reaction to important things or occasions. Environmental influences are known as stress variables. The emotional state of a person health may be significantly influenced by prolonged explanation to multiple upsetting experiences at once, which may lead to unsolved health issues. Early detection of strain issues is crucial for prevention, and this can only be done by regular stress monitoring. Continuous and real-time data collection is made possible by wearable devices, which contributes to an increase. This work uses deep learning-based techniques and detecting devices to implement an analysis of stress discovery. The proposed study aims to explore stress detection methods in various contexts, including travel and education, and in conjunction with hardware such as heart rate variability (HRV), electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), and electrocardiogram (ECG). Genetic algorithm is applied to separate the features, and the Stress Monitoring Algorithm - Long Short Term Memory (SMA-LSTM) is used to arrange the given data using dataset values. Pre-processing methods is used for eliminating signal artifacts are given beforehand. A report is sent to the patient or doctor by an expert who predicts mental stress via the Internet when the stress level exceeds the threshold value, labelling it as emergency or alert. Lastly, the accuracy, f1score, and precision are analyzed and compared, and recall outcomes to latest technique.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Online Marketing Training Course Based on Dokeos
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and e-commerce, online marketing has become one of the important means of enterprise marketing. Online marketing is a systematic project that needs to be carried out from multiple aspects and perspectives. The traditional network marketing training course system has its own characteristics in content and form, and there are also shortcomings in design and development. In this context, the article introduces the Dokeos learning platform as a carrier for the design and development of online marketing training courses. Focusing on tasks, this article provides users with rich learning resources and convenient learning methods through contextualized, visual, and intelligent technologies, while supporting interactive activities between teachers, students, and learners. The results showed that after the Dokeos based online marketing training course was put into operation, the highest learning efficiency of students reached 93.1%, and good results were also achieved in the satisfaction survey.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Low Power Security-Oriented SRAMs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The vulnerability of security systems to Power Analysis (PA) attacks, exploiting the analysis of current from the system's power supply, poses a serious threat. Embedded memories, a critical component of these systems, often utilize 6T Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) cells. However, Side-channel PA attacks can be launched against common SRAM cells because of the intrinsic connection between the written data and current characteristics. In our prior work, we introduced a security-focused 7T SRAM cell [1], incorporating an additional transistor and a two-phase write operation to significantly mitigate the relation between power consumption and stored data while write operations, providing resistance against such attacks. In this paper, we present a security-oriented 8T SRAM [8] that leverages a sleep transistor to reduce the power consumed by the security-oriented 7T SRAM. Additionally, we introduce a 10T SRAM that fulfills the functionalities of the security-focused 8T SRAM, offering benefits such as faster access times, improved stability, and reduced leakage current. Implemented in a 90 nm technology, the proposed SRAM cells exhibit approximately 250% lower Static Power Dissipation compared to the original security-oriented 7T SRAM [1].

articleTitle: IDLOA: Prioritized Task Scheduling for Optimizing Resource Utilization in Cloud-Fog Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In Cloud-Fog Computing (CFC) environment efficient task scheduling is crucial for optimizing resource utilization and system performance. This paper presents a novel approach by integrating the Improved Dingo Optimization Algorithm (IDOA) and the Lion Optimization Algorithm (LOA) into the Improved Dingo Lion Optimization Algorithm (IDLOA). Inspired by dingo and lion foraging behavior, IDLOA offers a nature-inspired optimization technique for dynamic task allocation in CFC environments. The methodology aims to minimize response time, energy usage, and overall operational costs by dynamically adapting to changing conditions. Extensive simulations and comparative analyses demonstrate that IDLOA outperforms existing algorithms, reducing response time, energy usage, and operational costs by 21%,32%, and 27%, respectively. These results highlight the significant contribution of IDLOA to optimizing CFC environments, emphasizing its potential for real-world applications requiring efficient resource utilization.

articleTitle: Ethical Design of Edge-based Smart Irrigation System by use Case Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Smart irrigation systems are based on Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and big data technologies, and they have the advantages of optimizing the water consumption, while ensuring the maximum crop yield. It is essential to ensure that the deployed smart irrigation systems are ethically designed, to build the trust of the users. Trust is established by compliance to agreed-upon ethical rules, regulations, and policies, along with technological aspects in the design of the system. Privacy and security, form the technological basis for ethical IoT design. The goal of this paper is to present an approach for designing a smart irrigation system that is ethical. The steps involved in the proposed approach are, definition of system architecture and identifying its elements, analyzing the security and privacy vulnerabilities by use case analysis, application of the existing solutions, and finally, the evaluation on how ethical is the system design. Although there is literature available on ethical design of IoT in general, the lack of use cases for smart irrigation vertical, motivates this paper.

articleTitle: DeMedia: Decentralization of Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Social media networks have become an essential part of the modern world, with billions of people using them as an integral part of their daily lives. Despite their popularity, these networks are centralized, allowing the companies that own them to monitor and track their users' activities. This has given rise to serious concerns regarding the privacy and security of user data, which are often sold to third parties for profit. Given the massive value of user data in today's and tomorrow's world, many people are concerned about this issue. While decentralized, community-driven applications have emerged as a potential solution to this problem, none have yet been able to compete with centralized social network platforms. Due to those facts, this research aimed to propose a decentralized social network architecture that would incorporate the basic functionalities of a social media platform while ensuring the privacy and security of users' data, which would be stored locally on their devices. A thorough study of the existing centralized and decentralized social media platforms was conducted to identify the path for this research. The proposed protocol offers a decentralized and secure social media platform architecture that provides true ownership of user data along with decentralized data integrity and caching.

articleTitle: Advancing Cardiovascular Health Prediction: Machine Learning Algorithm Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this study focused on heart disease prediction using machine learning, an analysis of three key algorithms- Random Forest, Logistic Regression, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)- was conducted utilizing a dataset comprising information from 1025 patients. The outcomes revealed the Random Forest algorithm's exceptional performance, achieving a flawless 97.24% prediction accuracy, while Logistic Regression demonstrated strong predictive ability at approximately 87.80%. KNN showcased moderate predictive power with an accuracy of around 74.63%. These findings underscore the potential of machine learning, particularly Random Forest, in aiding heart disease prediction, emphasizing the importance of algorithm selection based not only on accuracy but also on interpretability and practical implementation within healthcare contexts, aiming to enhance diagnostic precision and patient care.

articleTitle: Exploring the Theoretical Dimensions and Intricate Behaviors of Large Language Models and their Multimodal Counterparts
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an explosion of development and change in the field of big language models and their multimodal equivalents. Natural language processing, synthesis, and multimodal data fusion have all been significantly aided by these models, which are based on deep learning architectures. In this study, we set out to investigate the theoretical depths and complex behaviors of these big language models to better understand their potential and limitations. We start by investigating the theoretical underpinnings of the models' construction and operation. We go into their capability to understand context and create coherent language, and we unveil the complexities of its design, from Transformers to attention processes. The dynamic growth of these models, which have moved beyond linguistic barriers to accommodate multimodal input, is discussed along with the use of pre-trained embeddings and transfer learning. We also look at how these models perform in a wide range of contexts, from NLP to computer vision and beyond. We look at the difficulties of biases and fairness in interpreting them and in applying them. We gain understanding of how they might be improved upon in terms of performance, robustness, and scalability. At the heart of this investigation is a suggested strategy for making the most of big language models and their multimodal relatives. To uncover these models' untapped potential and underlying biases, this unique method combines Layer Weight Analysis, Attention Mechanism Analysis, and Ethical Bias Detection. Our results show the impressive efficacy of these models in tackling difficult real-world issues, but they also highlight the critical necessity to address issues of interpretability and fairness.

articleTitle: Designing Explainable Defenses Against Sophisticated Adversarial Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The requirement for strong defenses against complex adversarial assaults is increasing fast in the constantly evolving AI ecosystem. Considering this need, we put up the Explain Defend Net architecture, a unique adversarial defensive mechanism. This framework utilizes state-of-the-art methods to improve the robustness, openness, and flexibility of models. To protect the model from external interference, the Robust Feature Recalibrator (RFR) selectively adjusts the calibration of input features. The Explain Intercept Layer (EIL) offers transparency by offering interpretable insights into the decision-making process, enhancing human comprehension. The model can adapt to new forms of adversarial attack because of the dynamic adaptability guaranteed by Adaptive Reinforce Guard (ARG). With its comprehensive defensive strategy, Explain Defend Net is designed to outperform more conventional approaches. The suggested framework is put through rigorous testing, and the results indicate that it outperforms six established approaches in a wide range of categories. The findings show that Explain Defend Net regularly outperforms conventional techniques, proving its efficacy in protecting AI systems from malicious actors. Explain Defend Net is state-of-the-art in the field of adversarial defense because of its novel mix of recalibration, interpretability, and adaptive reinforcement.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Electricity Consumption and Economic Growth: An Empirical Analysis based on VAR Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Electricity is an important foundation for the development of the national economy and the normal operation of modern society, and there is a close relationship between electricity consumption and economic and social development. To study the interactive relationship between electricity consumption and economic growth, this paper takes the data on electricity consumption and economic growth of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region from 2006 to 2022 as the research object and uses the vector autoregressive model, Granger causality test, and the impulse response function to explore the dynamic correlation relationship between the gross domestic product (GDP) and the whole society's electricity consumption. The results show that there is a long-term equilibrium relationship between economic growth and electricity consumption in Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. However, there is only one-way Granger cause between economic growth and electricity consumption, and the influence degree shows a downward trend. The results show that the economic growth of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region plays an irreplaceable role in the increase of electricity consumption. In the future, the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region should vigorously develop clean energy and optimize the structure of electricity consumption to achieve the dual goals of economic development and energy conservation and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Secure Smart Home Data by Using Blockchain Technology with Hash Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The project “Secure Smart Home Data by Using Blockchain Technology with Hash Algorithm” focuses on incorporating two timeless technological concepts that is, blockchain and secure hash algorithms. Smart home is a concept that is been trending these days with IoT devices taking control of the houses making people's lives much easier. But the data collected from them is not stored properly. With the traditional methodology where the data is stored on a centralized cloud network, it is prone to cyberattacks, single point of failure and also involves tampering. Because of this, the sensitive data of the users are compromised from time to time. This arises mainly due to the centralized network system of the cloud and to tackle that, we approached a decentralized network system which Blockchain. It enables us to store data across the world that too in a decentralized format resulting in a more secure and safe environment for those sensitive data. This is our proposed solution as well. To secure the smart home data with blockchain technology and to further enhance reliability, our proposed approach incorporates a modified version of SHA-512. In summary, our focus is on securing Smart Home IoT data in the cloud by integrating blockchain technology, advanced encryption methods, and robust hash algorithms like SHA-512 to ensure the utmost protection and authorized access for large-scale datasets from diverse Smart Home sources.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Bank Customers Churn Prediction using AI/ML
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This is the Era where no. of customers are increases day by day in every business [1] and Customer have more than one choice in each and every aspect whether it is financial, governmental, organizational etc. In this project we are mainly discuss about the customer churn prediction in Banking sector. Customer churn is one of the problem of banking sector where industries are not able to hold their customers due to several fluctuating reasons such as better services at lower cost, bank location etc [2]. Hence Maintaining a good relationship with customers is crucial because it costs more to attract new ones than it does to retain existing ones in today's market[3]. Through this Research we want to proposed the solution of this problem using Machine learning (ML) approach. In Our Research work we applied many ML or DL algorithms such as Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, SVM, Artificial Neural Network, Random Forest classifier etc on Churn Modelling Bank dataset to predict the Probability of customer who are going to be Exited. This prediction helps the banking sector to identify the factors that leads the customer to be Exited so that they are able to improve the relationship with the customers. At the end of our research work we finally reach to the conclusion that Random Forest classifier predicts more accurate result compared to other ML or DL algorithms. Random Forest Classifier predicts the result with the test accuracy of 86.05 % without handling imbalanced data, 95.16% after oversampling with duplicate data, 89.548% after SMOTE oversampling, 74.69% after under sampling. A significant limitation of our model is its lack of training on real-time data. Instead, it relies solely on the Kaggle Bank churn dataset for its learning. Real-time data often presents dynamic and evolving patterns that might differ from those captured in the static dataset. The result and performance of the models may be further improved by using some other algorithms or by increasing the no. of hidden layers in ANN or by using Real Time Dataset.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Machine Learning Techniques Used for Early Detection of Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Skin cancer can be one of the most lethal diseases, caused by the abnormal development of skin cells exposed to UV radiation. It can cause metastasis and have significant mortality rates if not identified at the earliest. Detecting skin cancer at the early stages improves patient recovery rate to 99 % for 5 years. Melanoma can be identified at early stages by using the images of affected spots on the body of a patient. Diagnosing skin diseases through images is foremost challenging tasks in medical analysis. It's quite a complex task for human to recognize the type of cancer of the skin, accurately by looking at patient's skin lesion directly or through images. Machine learning comes into the picture by introducing various approaches in medical analysis to make these tasks simple. In this work, the role of machine learning algorithms is analysed systematically by considering the researcher's contributions to the early diagnosis of skin cancer. The HAM10000 dataset is considered for the implementation of five ML models. The results are analysed in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score. The results evidence that ML techniques are working well in the prediction of skin cancer.

articleTitle: A Real Time Data Monitoring for Spinning Mill Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time data monitoring system for spinning mills using Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The system uses sensors to collect data from various machines in the spinning mill and transmits the data wirelessly to a central server. The composed information is then handled and analyzed to detect anomalies and predict potential failures in the spinning mill equipment. The system also provides real-time alerts to the mill operators, enabling them to take timely corrective actions and prevent downtime. The proposed system offers significant benefits in terms of improved equipment performance, reduced maintenance costs, and increased productivity. Overall, the proposed system demonstrates the potential of IoT technology in enhancing the efficiency and reliability of spinning mills.

articleTitle: An Introductory Guide on Creating a Pandas-based EEG Analysis and Action Prediction Tool for BCI Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Brain computer interfaces (BCIs) are rapidly gaining a lot of momentum within the biomedical engineer's sphere. The BCI is a link between the brain's electrical activity and a device that monitors actions and functions based on its input. In this paper, we have created a prediction algorithm for BCI systems that takes in EEG data (i.e., data classified based on actions) using machine learning (ML) techniques. Furthermore, EEG data is obtained and subsequently examined under specific conditions. This is necessary as the data would otherwise lack significance for computation. This is due to the fact that EEG data mostly consists of highly disordered electrical brain wave activity. In the analysis phase of this study, many Python libraries could be used ranging from the MNE library which is an essential tool used in EEG analysis to scikit which is used in many branches of ML. This project has a special emphasis on the use of Pandas for ML. The project's EEG data has been obtained from workers and interns of the Turkish government agency called scientific and technological research council of Türkiye (TÜBİTAK). While the data was being recorded, a special EEG recording software has been used that assigns condition inputs that attach them to the epoched time data.

articleTitle: Bridging the Gap Between Modalities with Cross-Modal Generative AI and Large Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The Multi-Modal Cross-Attention Network (MCAN) is a revolutionary way to bridge the gap between varied data modalities that has emerged in response to the growing field of cross-modal generative AI and huge models. In this work, we highlight the substantial benefits of MCAN and provide its important contributions, aims, motivations, research issues, and solutions. MCAN has changed the game by dominating key performance indicators. One of its most distinguishing features is its innate accuracy in aligning various data modalities. This alignment is made easier with the use of cutting-edge cross-modal attention techniques, guaranteeing the smooth incorporation of data from many sources like pictures, text, and audio. When it comes to reconstructing information from several sources, The intended meaning is more likely to be preserved since MCAN makes material more semantically consistent. Uniformity is crucial for content-based recall and image-text matching. With its advanced ethical concerns in content creation and greater generalization to unseen material, MCAN is a cutting-edge solution in the rapidly developing area of cross-modal generative AI. When it comes to huge models and cross-modal generative AI, MCAN is a major step forward.

articleTitle: Research on Transparency and Optimization of Aviation Materials Supply Chain based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This research delves into the transformative impact of blockchain technology on the aviation material supply chain, with a focus on enhancing transparency and optimization. Using AC Airlines as a case study, the paper illustrates the substantial benefits derived from the implementation of blockchain in supply chain management. The results indicate a noteworthy 33% reduction in procurement cycle time, showcasing the efficiency gains achieved through blockchain. Additionally, there is a remarkable 40% decrease in average inventory costs, underscoring the financial advantages associated with blockchain adoption. The study emphasizes the significant improvement in transparency throughout the supply chain, a critical factor in the aviation industry. Blockchain technology not only streamlines processes but also enhances visibility, contributing to better decision-making and risk management. The findings further reveal a 66% increase in emergency material response efficiency, demonstrating the pivotal role of blockchain in facilitating quick and effective responses to unforeseen events. A key highlight of this research is the substantial 75% cut in annual supply chain incident costs, signifying the resilience and risk mitigation capabilities offered by blockchain. The paper argues for blockchain's potential to strengthen overall supply chain resilience, positioning it as a strategic tool for gaining a competitive advantage in the aviation sector.

articleTitle: Gender Classification from Facial Images Using Combinations of Wavelet, PCA/LDA AND SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Recognition gender from face are very important in todays security system. It simplifies the task of face analysis and recognition. This article presents two ways to classify gender using facial expressions. The first method combines PCA with wavelets while the second method combines LDA with wavelets for feature extraction. Embedded wavelet decomposition overcomes the limitations of PCA and LDA and improves gender classification. First, use wavelet to extract the predicted face image from the original face image. This wavelet characteristic is robust to local effects caused by changes in illumination, direction, and noise. Then, the predicted image is projected into low-dimensional space using the PCA/LDA technique to find the disparity vectors. Then the wavelet-based PCA/LDA feature vector is applied to the SVM/KNN classifier for the image to extract important information (image) and remove irrelevant information from the face sale. PCA/LDA is applied to these predicted images to find the difference vectors. The distribution value of the extraction method results was analyzed using kNN and SVM classifiers. To compare the proposed method, experiments were conducted on facial images taken in cold and unconditioned conditions. The suggested work in this paper gives acceptable output both image data taken on a natural background and on the data of images taken on an uncontrolled background. Wavelet decomposition using PCA and RBF SVM gives classification rate more than 95% with small feature vectors on Real, FERET, SUMS, FEI A and FEI B databases

articleTitle: The Role of Cognitive Radio in Optimizing Spectrum Utilization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Spectrum optimization is a key objective in wireless communication as data-intensive services proliferate. Cognitive radio technology, which handles airwaves smartly and flexiblely, may solve this problem. Cognitive radio's role in spectrum optimization is examined in this article. We examine the technology's theoretical and practical applications. Cognitive radio technology aims to make radios “smart” enough to “think,” “learn,” and “self-optimize” to maximize airwave consumption. For years, static spectrum distribution and underutilized airwaves have been issues. Cognitive radios' reading, figuring, and acting talents might revolutionize spectrum allocation. In this work, we discuss “Dynamic Spectrum Allocation (DSA) with Cognitive Radio.” Decision-making, spectrum sensing, and spectrum allocation are combined. This strategy outperforms others in our controlled testbed trials. Cognitive radio excels in spectrum reading, decisionmaking, and spectrum allocation, demonstrating its spectrum management potential. In our study, we discuss the laws and restrictions that govern cognitive radio usage in shared spectrum bands. It emphasizes the FCC's role in crafting these regulations. The IEEE 802.22 standard for Wireless Regional Area Networks in TV White Spaces has made cognitive radio technology more practical.

articleTitle: Impact of Lightning Impulse on the Performance of Microgrid and Low-voltage AC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A photovoltaic (PV) generator integrated low voltage (LV) distribution system may be affected by lightning strikes due to thunderstorms. In this paper, a PV generatorintegrated LV distribution network is considered to analyse the effect of lightning causing the generation of a travelling wave. The lightning impulse is modelled and simulated at various locations of the proposed model. The voltage and current profiles due to the injection of lightning impulse have been analysed. The variations in frequency causing changes in impedance are also observed in the proposed model simulated using MATLAB-Simulink software. In addition, it is observed that the nominal voltage and current waveforms at different buses are affected by the lightning impulse voltage, and the impact of lightning voltage gradually decreases as the distance of the line from the point of lightning increases. This kind of simulation work of lightning impulse and its effect on power systems will be beneficial for the power system engineers/researchers at the level of research and development of protection systems of AC distribution networks/microgrids. The proposed methodology is reproducible for the analysis of lightning effects on grid-connected LV microgrid systems for any other models, irrespective of the nature of resources and their geographical locations.

articleTitle: ExoSpikeNet: A Light Curve Analysis Based Spiking Neural Network for Exoplanet Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Exoplanets are celestial bodies orbiting stars beyond our Solar System. Although historically they posed detection challenges, Kepler's data has revolutionized our understanding. By analyzing flux values from t he Kepler (K2) Mission, we investigate the intricate patterns in starlight that may indicate the presence of exoplanets. This study has investigated a novel approach for exoplanet classification using spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) applied to the data obtained from the NASA Kepler (K2) mission. SNNs offer a unique advantage by mimicking the spiking behavior of neurons in the brain, allowing for more nuanced and biologically inspired processing of temporal data. Experimental results showcase the efficacy of the proposed SNN architecture, excelling in terms of various performance metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, precision, and recall.

articleTitle: Global Analysis of Quality Problems in Digital Engineering by Whale Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In order to solve the challenge of global analysis of quality problems in digital engineering, in view of the shortcomings of the existing D-P algorithms, this study proposes an innovative global analysis method for quality problems based on whale algorithms. The new solution uses the principles of machine learning Xi optimization theory to accurately identify and locate key influencing factors, and accordingly makes a sensible classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, using the unique mechanism of the whale algorithm, the scheme cleverly constructs a design strategy for global analysis of the problem. The empirical results show that this scheme shows a significant improvement compared with the traditional D-P algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the global analysis of quality problems, the processing efficiency of key factors, and other key performance indicators, showing its obvious strong advantages. In digital engineering, the global analysis of quality problems plays a crucial role, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of the global analysis of quality problems in digital engineering. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional D-P algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this problem, this study introduces a new idea of global analysis of the quality problem of whale algorithm optimization, accurately controls the influencing parameters through machine Xi optimization theory, and uses this as a road map for index allocation, and then uses whale algorithm to innovate and construct a system scheme. The test results clearly point out that in the context of the evaluation criteria, the new scheme has been significantly optimized in terms of accuracy and processing speed for a variety of challenges, showing stronger performance superiority. Therefore, in the global analysis of quality problems in digital engineering, the simulation scheme based on whale algorithm successfully overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional D-P algorithm, and significantly improves the accuracy and operation efficiency of the simulation.

articleTitle: 3D Film and Television Animation Production Cloud Management System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: 3D film and television animation production is a complex and time-consuming task. Traditional production methods have low efficiency and quality control problems. In order to solve these problems, an artificial intelligence-based 3D film and television animation production cloud management system came into being. This study adopted a comprehensive research methodology, including literature review, user research, and field testing. First of all, this study conducts an in-depth study of relevant literature, and understands the current situation and problems of 3D film and television animation production. Secondly, this study conducted a field test on the artificial intelligence-based 3D film and television animation production cloud management system, and collected user feedback and opinions. The research results show that the artificial intelligence-based cloud management system for 3D film and television animation production has a positive impact on user experience. The system improves production efficiency and production quality through intelligent auxiliary tools and automatic functions. User feedback shows that the real-time preview and feedback function of the system enables users to adjust the work in time and obtain more detailed and realistic effects. In addition, the system's interface design and personalized customization options are also appreciated by users, which improves the user's work comfort and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Machine Learning for Predictive Policing and Crime Pattern Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Crime pattern analysis and other forms of predictive policing are becoming indispensable tools for today's police forces. Hybrid Blockchain-Machine Learning Predictive Policing (HBL-PP) is a new method introduced by this study that aims to transform the sector by bringing together the best features of blockchain technology and machine learning algorithms. SecureCrimeChain guarantees the safe handling of crime-related data, while Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are used for advanced crime pattern analysis in HBL-PP. When compared to conventional approaches, HBL-PP performs much better in experimental evaluations. SecureCrimeChain guarantees the best degree of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, outperforming other techniques. DeepCrimeNet has comparable performance and comes in a close second. FairPredict Pro, although fairness-aware, maintains a balance between equity and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Dual-band Patch Antenna for GPS and WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The work proposes a microstrip antenna for usage from 840 to 1500 MHz. The antenna is about 80 × 40 × 1.6 mm3, which is quite small. The antenna is made up of a straightforward geometric construction with a 3- shaped structure that is supplied by a microstrip patch antenna operating under the meander line effect, which can be adjusted to change the antenna's size. Additionally, DGS is used for reducing the antenna size, achieving the extra modes of resonance and wide operational bandwidth. 530MHz–1970MHz and return loss of −19.8 dB and −19 dB at the resonating frequencies of 920 MHz and 1500 MHz.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Optimization of Wireless Sensor Networks Lifetime using Soft Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The paper presents a novel approach to address the problem of lifetime maximization in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) with limited initial energy constraints. The authors introduce a scheduling approach called Non-disjoint Set Cover (NDSC) and propose a method based on the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize the lifetime of randomly deployed WSNs. The approach involves dividing the problem into two sub-problems. The first sub-problem focuses on finding the maximum number of NDSCs that achieve full coverage of the targets in the area. PSO, using a heuristic method, is employed to address this sub-problem. The second sub-problem deals with finding an optimal scheduling approach to maximize the WSN lifetime while considering the limited initial energy reserve in each sensor. Again, PSO, based on a heuristic method, is used to tackle this sub-problem. The NDSCs obtained from the first sub-problem serve as inputs for the scheduling in the second sub-problem. The solutions obtained by the proposed NDSC-PSO method are compared with those obtained by the NDSC-GA (Genetic Algorithm) method from the literature. Additionally, the quality of the NDSC-PSO solutions is evaluated by comparing them with exact solutions obtained using an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) method from the literature. The experimental results demonstrate that the NDSC-PSO method outperforms the NDSC-GA method in terms of finding optimal solutions for the same instances. The proposed method effectively maximizes the lifetime of WSNs while considering limited initial energy constraints. The paper contributes to the existing literature by presenting a novel approach that utilizes the PSO algorithm for finding NDSCs and scheduling them in WSNs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Inspection Robot Scene Recognition under Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, intelligent substation detection robots are becoming a new favorite in the industry. It not only improves the detection efficiency of the substation, but also improves the detection accuracy. At the same time, the integration of multiple advanced technologies endows these robots with unique functions and characteristics. Substation is an important component of the power system, and its working state directly affects the stability of power supply. Traditional, usually manual inspection methods are not only inefficient but also prone to errors. The emergence of intelligent inspection robots has completely changed the inspection method of substations, allowing for large-scale inspections in a short period of time, with much higher accuracy than manual operations. The total number of surveyed data within 24 hours for the intelligent inspection robot scene recognition using convolutional neural networks is 198, with only 2 unmeasured data. However, it can be seen that the intelligent inspection robot scene recognition using convolutional neural networks can quickly and accurately recognize.

articleTitle: Analysis of New Power System Digitization Scheme Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the development of the metaverse, the application of digital twin technology in power systems will become increasingly widespread. Digital twin is a technology that simulates the physical world and maps simulation results to the virtual world, while predicting how the physical world works. The application of digital twin technology in the power system can improve the operational level of the power system from different levels. This article first introduces the relationship between the metaverse and digital twins, and then proposes a new digital solution for power systems based on digital twin technology. To provide reference for the construction of new power systems. Through research, it has been found that the metaverse is an immersive experience based on virtual reality, aimed at creating an open platform for users to create, design, interact, and experience digital content, which can help establish a highly realistic digital world and provide better services for people.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Posterior Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Currently, the vast majority of international interactions and activities related to trade, government, culture, social interaction, and economics take place online. These interactions involve people, non-governmental organizations, governments, and government agencies at all levels. Recently, a sizeable number of commercial firms and government organizations all over the world have been presented with the challenge offered by cyberattacks as well as the danger represented by wireless communication technologies. A very little amount of time has passed since this had place. We were able to develop a model for the risk of cyber security by making use of Bayesian Networks. This model has the capability of locating the point of cyber security that is weak and merging two different cyber analysis models. Among these is the activityquality model, which shows how individuals and/or groups adhere to the legal requirements for cyber security. Evidence describing the critical component of cyber security for a research reactor's RPS may be produced via the cyber security risk model. An further model that shows the probability of a cyberattack against RPS architecture is the cyber security risk model.

articleTitle: Ensemble Machine Learning and Feature Selection for Effective Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Malware detection is a crucial aspect of cyber security, as malicious software leads to a significant threat to the integrity and security of digital systems. With the constantly evolving nature of malware, traditional signature-based detection methods struggle to keep pace with appearing threats. In recent years, machine learning has become visible as a promising solution to enhance malware detection capabilities, leveraging its ability to identify complex patterns and adapt to new attack vectors. This paper presents an extensive study of malware detection using machine learning techniques. Machine learning algorithms, including adaboost ensemble learning, stacking ensemble learning, hard voting ensemble learning, and soft voting ensemble that have been employed to tackle the challenge of malware classification. Furthermore, we explore the Variance threshold and wrapper based forward feature engineering process, delving into the extraction of relevant features from malware samples to enable effective machine learning-based detection. In this paper, Malware detection techniques applied on the dataset CCCS-CIC-AndMal-2020 and get the accuracy of 99.48%.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Generation of Over Clock Attack for Security Assessment of Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Recent research findings indicate the rise of cyber security threats issues in the field of IOT. It has become essential to study and analyze the effects of fault injection attacks effects in IOT industry. Research article presents an algorithm that generates over clock attack. Algorithm: assembly code introduced in this research work may be beneficial for industry experts as testing platforms for performing analysis of fault injection attacks on various embedded devices circuits. It may further enhance the capability of engineers to build countermeasures so as to build attack resistant devices.

articleTitle: Neural Network Strategies for Enhancing Mid and Near-Field Optics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the major goals of enhancing picture quality, correcting aberrations, and optimizing light-matter interactions, the suggested technique makes use of neural network methodologies to improve mid- and near-field optics. This strategy makes use of three fundamental algorithms: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) image restoration, Wavefront Sensing aberration correction, and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) nanostructure optimization. The first approach, Image Restoration using CNNs, leverages deep convolutional neural networks to recover images in mid- and near-field optics, collecting complicated characteristics in the process. The second approach, Aberration Correction using Wavefront Sensing, employs wavefront sensing techniques to quantify and correct optical aberrations. The third approach, Nanostructure Optimization using GANs, employs a generative adversarial network to create nanostructures optimized for certain optical tasks. The success of the suggested technique is measured with regards to metrics like the enhancement of image quality (PSNR), the accuracy of aberration correction (RMS wavefront error), and the effectiveness of optimizing nanostructures (FOM). Together, these methods tackle the problems plaguing the field and improve the quality of optical pictures captured at mid- and near-field distances.

articleTitle: Research on Model Optimization Based on ISM and DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In view of the 17 interrelated Sustainable Development Aims formulated, we first use the grey correlation degree correlation degree coupling model for analysis and processing to obtain the correlation degree and relationship network diagram. Then, we use the DEMATEL model to draw a causal relationship diagram and predict the goals for the next 10 years. Finally, the Grey Relational Grade ISD coupling model is used to obtain the development goal with the highest correlation degree with the Sustainable Development Goals. After assuming that the development goals with the highest correlation with the sustainable development goals are achieved, we analyse the relationship network diagram between the remaining SDGs and discuss the top three SDGs with the highest correlation. This paper implements a relationship network graph generated from 17 SDGs, and discusses the strengths and weaknesses of the Grey Relational Grade, ISM model, and DEMATEL model, leaving room for further research.

articleTitle: Recognition of Valid QR Codes with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The widespread use of Quick Response (QR) codes has made QR codes an attractive target for cyberattacks, posing a security and privacy concern. Quick Response (QR) codes have revolutionized marketing strategies by providing a fast and efficient way to connect offline and online platforms. However, the security issues arise as the usage of QR codes. This paper introduces an automatic detector that identifies QR code images and lets the user know whether it is malicious or benign. To achieve this, a dataset of 10,000 original and malicious QR code images (both) is taken. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is employed to classify original and malicious codes. Additionally, histogram density analysis is incorporated to enhance feature identification, leading to improved classification accuracy. This paper implemented ResNet50, MobilenetV3 and InceptionV3 CNN models for evaluating the abilities to predict the malicious codes. The InceptionV3 model emerges as the most promising, attaining an accuracy of 98.13%, offering an efficient and accurate solution for document forensics and counterfeit detection.

articleTitle: Redesigned Cloud Service Migration Techniques for Improved Portability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cloud computing has transformed IT resource management. Businesses benefit from cloud computing's agility, scalability, and cost reductions. Mobile cloud services are essential in the age of rapidly growing hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructures. The complete strategy described in this article may improve cloud service transfer efficiency and portability across cloud platforms. An approach combining three algorithms is proposed. These algorithms include the Automated Migration Planner, Dependency Analysis, and Portability Score. The main component is the DAA. This research examines cloud service dependencies. Data Analytics and Assessment (DAA) finds service-data interdependencies via connections and complexity. PSA evaluates dependence and vendor lock-in to determine service portability. The Portability Score Algorithm helped enterprises make better decisions by accurately assessing service portability. This was done by giving businesses accurate service ratings. The Automated Transfer Planner cut migration expenses, outages, and hours. This was done by developing realistic and well-engineered transfer tactics. This research advances cloud computing by providing improved tools to enterprises to move between cloud services, avoid provider lock-in, and improve multi-cloud and hybrid cloud strategies. This study is vital to cloud computing.

articleTitle: Comparison of Noise Removal Methods for Noisy Lenke Type 1 Idiopathic Scoliosis Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Improving the quality of medical images is essential for accurate clinical diagnosis. However, medical images are often plagued by various types of noise, posing challenges to the reliability and accuracy of image diagnosis. This study aims to compare Anisotropic, Wiener, Median, Average, and Gaussian filters on noisy images to improve the quality and accuracy of diagnostic results. To better adapt to the complex features in Lenke images, the contrast optimization algorithm was enhanced using Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). In this study, artificial noise modeling (Gaussian and Quantum noise) was applied to Lenke X-ray images, and a comparative analysis was performed to discover the most effective filtering scheme for a particular type of noise based on various parameters such as MSE, PSNR, SNR, and SSIM. The results unveiled that the Wiener filter was relatively effective for both types of noise. The Gaussian filter also performed satisfactorily. Nonetheless, no filter could be declared the most effective for both types of noise. However, their performance varied according to the type of noise present and the evaluation parameters.

articleTitle: Network Information Security Technology and Application Based on SOM-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the opening up of network system, the number of power companies continues to grow in the securities markets. On the basis of summarizing the previously studied model algorithms and taking into account the special market environment, this paper extracts the most essential core of studies on network information security early-warning and proposes a network information security system for power enterprises by models of information security. Finally, the network information security early-warning and monitoring system is built through BP neural network using the classified five grades of samples. In addition, predictive accuracy of the proposed model algorithm is analyzed by comparison with other model algorithms. The results show that the proposed network information security early-warning system can further classify the relatively optimal ST and non-ST sample data obtained into five grades as the input information of SOM network, namely crisis, severe warning, warning, alert and normal, to finally acquire five grades of sample objects.

articleTitle: TBNet: A Reliable and Efficient Neural Network for Tuberculosis Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The next generation of MobileNets is presented in this article, which is built on merging various fundamental blocks and an entirely novel architecture design for computer vision and embedded applications. This design increases Tuberculosis (TB) detection while utilising little computing resources. This architecture is compared to other state-of-theart Novel architectures, demonstrating its capability. This neural network builds on the original MobileNet architecture by including Bi-Directional block to extract more features from images for improved detection and outcomes. MobileNet design is the foundation for our architecture; it is built on MobileNet, but the hyperparameters are tailored to the application's needs to identify tuberculosis in human lungs.

articleTitle: Fusion of Word Embedding and Encoder Decoder Model for Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Extractive text summarization is a core activity in the field of natural language processing, aiming to condense the most important information from a given text while preserving its core meaning. This study investigates a novel methodology that integrates word embeddings using GLOVE and LSTM based encoder decoder model, two widely recognized methodologies, to enhance the effectiveness of extractive summarization. This novel approach incorporates the advantages of both word embeddings and LSTM to enhance the summarization process. Word embeddings can capture semantic links between words and phrases, so facilitating a more profound comprehension of textual context. Encoder decoder-based LSTM model identifies predicted summary based on the original summary. BLEU and cosine similarity are metrics that evaluates the importance of terms in a collection of documents, so guaranteeing that crucial phrases are given suitable weighting. An algorithm is provided for the task of extracting text summarizing, wherein sentence embedding is achieved by following word embedding, and the score of the summary is obtained. The model is tested on a dataset obtained from Kaggle and consists of news summaries. The model that was suggested obtained a BLEU score of 59.4% and a cosine similarity of 50.2 %; when these findings were compared with the state of the art work, it was found that the proposed model produced superior results.

articleTitle: Development Trend of Code Defect Detection Technology Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Traditional defect detection research is based on program analysis, and when dealing with large-scale programs, the detection speed is usually slow, resulting in limited detection performance. Moreover, because traditional defect detection can only extract basic semantic information, the detection accuracy is not high, which makes it difficult to play a role in practical applications. In recent years, with the progress of artificial intelligence technology, natural language processing technology has also been rapidly developed. Through natural language processing technology, more complex, highdimensional and multi-level semantic features can be extracted from the code, so that the code defect detection has a higher accuracy, and the detection speed has been significantly improved. In this paper, the author mainly collects the relevant literature of code defect detection based on CNN, RNN, LSTM and Transformer, which belongs to natural language processing technology, discusses the difficulties and challenges still existing in defect detection, and finally makes a summary and outlook for the future.

articleTitle: Dual-Stage Deep Learning Framework for Effective Public Physical Violence Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Violent acts endanger both personal safety and social peace. Various solutions have been considered to minimise such behaviours, including the establishment of surveillance systems. The development of surveillance equipment that can detect aggressive behaviour autonomously is critical. The suggested system requires two stages to be executed. It must first detect the presence of persons inside video frames, followed by the extraction of frames containing potential violence. Unnecessary frames are then removed, leaving only pertinent instances of aggressive behaviour that are preserved as separate pictures. Whenever feasible, the technology recognises the faces of persons taking part in the activities.. Two pre-trained models are combined for higher accuracy and faster processing, addressing limitations of relying solely on Convolutional Neural Networks. This innovative system holds promise for enhancing safety and security. This two-staged approach comprises Faster RCNN Inception V2 COCO and MobileNet V2 pre-trained models that offers improved accuracy and serves as a foundation for constructing the full model.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Control Strategy for Grid-Connected PV-Battery Systems under Adverse Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This work presents a new controller for gridconnected PV/Battery systems that combines a bidirectional battery controller with a voltage source converter (VSC) to solve problems caused by power fluctuations on the DC-link. The hybrid VSC controller is developed to maintain a continuous power supply on the DC-link. It does this by responding to changes in environmental factors and load fluctuations in the PV-generated output, which in turn triggers dynamic adjustments to the inverter pulse signals. To increase system stability, the bidirectional battery controller orchestrates the charge and discharge operations in collaboration with the hybrid VSC, optimizing power delivery to the grid. Through a detailed performance study of the proposed controller, faults on both the DC and AC sides of the system are analyzed and efficiently addressed. The controller proved important in enhancing power quality and decreasing harmonic distribution. Furthermore, the hybrid controller's performance is assessed under several one-day environmental situations. Ultimately, the results of simulation done in MATLAB/Simulink corroborate the usefulness of the suggested controller in providing optimal performance in the described grid-connected PV/Battery system.

articleTitle: Design, Modeling and Application of BIM Data Model Based on 3D Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: From the construction process, building construction is a highly professional and complex project. The traditional 2 D(Two-Dimensional) graphic design method is difficult to accurately control the BIM data which seriously restricts the information exchange, schedule control and standardized construction in the architectural design process. In this paper, a data model of building BIM (Building Information Modeling) based on three-dimensional collaboration is constructed by controlling the building structure diagram, working plane design documents, cost estimation and system evaluation, and the personnel composition, expenditure and time consumption of various construction elements of the building are comprehensively compared through this model. The entire experimental protocol was performed in a virtual environment, the traditional architectural design method costs 200,000 yuan in the preliminary design stage, and the three-dimensional collaborative BIM data model costs 100,000 yuan in the preliminary design stage. This scheme is more cost-saving.

articleTitle: Evolving Data Privacy Norms: Impact and Implications for Energy Internet Pricing Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 13th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The requirements for data privacy are changing, which affects energy Internet price plans.
